articles.title: La tenue Space Force rêvée par Trump puise dans deux films qui désignent les méchants de l'histoire, et la référence passe mal
articles.text:
L’image est apparue le 6 septembre 2026 sur Truth Social, le réseau social préféré de Donald Trump. Au milieu d’une interminable logorrhée générative, de messages enflammés et de clips à sa gloire, le président des États-Unis a présenté un visuel créé manifestement avec une intelligence artificielle, et censé présenter le futur look de la Space Force.
Visuellement, donc, on se retrouve face à un modèle d’officier sur fond gris sombre.
L’ensemble mise sur une coupe ajustée et une palette de couleurs ternes : gris anthracite, noir et quelques touches d’argent. La veste se ferme par un col rigide, complétée d’une ceinture noire à boucle métallique. Le militaire porte aussi des bottes hautes en cuir noir montant jusqu’aux genoux. Seul un modèle masculin est présenté.
L’image détaille aussi des éléments spécifiques de la tenue, parfaite pour la parade, avec un zoom sur les épaulettes, le col, les écussons, la ceinture et les exemples d’insignes de grade. Le logo de la Space Force est aussi mis en avant. On voit enfin un visuel avec le soldat portant une casquette assortie, et avec visière, avec le symbole spatial sur le devant.
On remarque enfin une indication d’inspiration sur le design. Le clin d’œil est explicitement assumé à Starship Troopers, un film de 1997 réalisé par Paul Verhoeven, et inspiré d’Étoiles, garde-à-vous !, un roman de 1959 écrit par Robert A. Heinlein. Une tenue qui a été « modernisée », mais qui en reprend la « discipline » et la « fonctionnalité ».
Bien sûr, le compte Rapid Response de la Maison-Blanche a relayé dans la foulée ce visuel sur X, afin d’accroitre sa visibilité. Il y a cependant un souci central : l’inspiration revendiquée par la photo pointe vers une œuvre qui va justement à l’opposé de la vision de Donald Trump. Starship Troopers se moque ouvertement du militarisme.
Par ailleurs, la Space Force possède déjà une vraie tenue d’apparat. Elle a été étrennée fin août 2026 au Freedom 250 Grand Prix de Washington par sa garde d’honneur, rapportait à l’époque Military Times. On y trouve une veste bleu foncé à fermeture diagonale, rehaussée d’une ceinture et d’un cordon bleu clair, entre autres.
Le dessin de Donald Trump, lui, ne sort d’aucun atelier de couture : ce n’est qu’un concept craché par un quelconque générateur d’images synthétiques.
Créée en 2019, cette branche reste la plus petite de l’armée américaine, avec un effectif d’à peine 14 000 personnes. Cette jeune structure a été très vite brocardée : son logo, dévoilé en 2020, avait déjà été moqué pour sa ressemblance avec l’insigne de Starfleet, dans Star Trek. Netflix en avait d’ailleurs tiré une série, mais elle était mauvaise.
Une satire du fascisme reprise au premier degré
En fait, le vrai malaise vient de la source assumée. Starship Troopers est une satire du fascisme et du militarisme. Le cinéaste néerlandais, qui est né lors de la Seconde guerre mondiale et a grandi aux Pays-Bas sous l’occupation nazie, y filme une société guerrière et autoritaire en poussant les codes de la propagande jusqu’à l’absurde.
Habiller de vrais soldats avec l’esthétique de ce film, au premier degré, revient donc à passer complètement à côté du propos politique du film. Le réalisateur ne s’en est jamais caché : dès 2017, alors que Donald Trump démarrait son premier mandat, il confiait à Interview Magazine voir un écho de la dystopie qu’il avait mise en images.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, beaucoup ont également pointé du doigt la très grande proximité stylistique entre la (future ?) tenue de la Space Force et les uniformes des militaires de l’Empire galactique. Cette lecture n’arrange rien : les vêtements des officiers impériaux s’inspirent directement des tenues de l’Allemagne nazie.
George Lucas l’a assumé de longue date, et répété souvent : il voulait un Empire efficace, totalitaire, fasciste, jusqu’au nom de certaines unités, les stormtroopers, calquées sur les sections d’assaut du parti nazi. La série Andor est d’ailleurs allée dans ce sens également, en convoquant là aussi l’histoire et le nazisme pour montrer l’horreur de l’Empire.
En somme, la tenue rêvée par le président pioche dans deux imageries qui désignent, chacune, les méchants de l’histoire.
Bien entendu, les moqueries n’ont pas tardé, comme les consternations. Sur Reddit, l’image a été largement partagée et raillée, des fils de r/politics aux vétérans de gauche, beaucoup relevant que l’inspiration est écrite noir sur blanc sur l’affiche. D’aucuns ont également ressorti des mèmes, comme ce clin d’œil au sketch Are We the Baddies?.
Le spécialiste de la mode masculine Derek Guy, a résumé le sentiment général : c’est, selon lui, le genre de costume qu’un chef décorateur dessine pour désigner les méchants d’un film de science-fiction. D’ailleurs, on a très vite vu des montages mettant côte à côte ce visuel avec les images tirées des deux sagas spatiales.
On ignore encore si Donald Trump compte vraiment imposer ce dessin, ou s’il s’agit d’une lubie de plus lâchée sur Truth Social au fil de la journée, dans le flot incessant des messages qu’il écrit. On ignore par ailleurs ce qui est le pire dans tout ça : que le président ou son équipe ait raté une lecture aussi évidente, ou qu’elle ait été comprise, et assumée.

articles.title: La Guardia Civil ha desmantelado en Almería un negocio muy lucrativo: cobrar una fortuna a inmigrantes y empadronarlos ilegalmente
articles.text:
Dieciocho personas detenidas. Tres grupos criminales desarticulados. 188 empadronamientos fraudulentos. La Guardia Civil de la Comandancia de Almería ha cerrado, de momento, la operación Tabula Rasa, un nombre que resume bien la intención: borrar de un plumazo una red que llevaba meses falsificando la residencia de decenas de extranjeros en Roquetas de Mar. La fórmula es muy parecida a la que vimos el año pasado en Madrid.
Primer chivatazo. La pista arrancó en 2025, con denuncias de vecinos normales y corrientes. Algunos descubrieron, al pedir un certificado de empadronamiento, que en su propio piso figuraban registradas personas que jamás habían visto. El fenómeno se concentró en bloques grandes, edificios con decenas de viviendas donde resulta más fácil camuflar altas irregulares. En Aguadulce, un solo inmueble acumulaba más de un centenar de empadronados. Lo irónico es que allí no vivía nadie.
Entre 800 y 2.500 euros por dirección. La investigación identificó a 69 víctimas estafadas, que pagaron esas cantidades a cambio de una dirección que no era la suya. El empadronamiento abre puertas: sanidad, escolarización, ayudas sociales, arraigo social. Y mueve mucho dinero. Los presuntos responsables falsificaban recibos de agua y luz y usaban, sin permiso, la identidad de propietarios reales para dar apariencia de legalidad a los trámites.
Detrás del papeleo se tipifican delitos como pertenencia a grupo criminal, favorecimiento de la inmigración ilegal, falsedad documental, estafa y usurpación de estado civil. Los arrestos se repartieron entre Adra, Almería capital, La Mojonera, El Ejido y Roquetas de Mar, la localidad donde se concentró el grueso de la trama.
Un precedente claro. Agosto ya dejó un precedente casi calcado: 47 empadronamientos irregulares en Almería, Níjar y Canjáyar. Y otros 15 detenidos por la Policía Nacional. Cuatro veces más altas fraudulentas detectadas en una sola operación. En cualquier caso, La Guardia Civil ha culminado la primera fase de la operación Tabula Rasa pero se presuponen más objetivos, así que el número de arrestos podría crecer.
De hecho, ayuntamientos como el de Gandía ya han endurecido su normativa municipal para vigilar de oficio los pisos con más de ocho empadronados y tramitar bajas automáticas cuando detectan fraude. En paralelo al precio de la vivienda y a la presión migratoria en zonas agrícolas del sureste.
Contexto. Almería capital cerró agosto de 2026 con un precio medio de 1.807 €/m², un 11,3% más que un año antes; Roquetas de Mar, donde se desarticuló la red, alcanzó los 1.762 €/m², un 17,4% interanual, con picos de hasta el 23-25% en primavera de 2026; El Ejido se situó en 1.365 €/m² en marzo, un 18,8% más, y lideró las subidas de alquiler en el primer trimestre (+12,7%, hasta 965 euros mensuales), la renta más cara de la provincia.
En paralelo, Almería, que tiene un mapa de extranjería especialmente complicado con unos 25.000 empleados sin papeles, concentra el 22,1% de la población extranjera de Andalucía, con el 59% de las altas laborales extranjeras en agricultura, 41.580 trabajadores extranjeros en el Sistema Especial Agrario en diciembre de 2025, Roquetas de Mar como municipio con más residentes no españoles (32.419), El Ejido con un 31,8% de población extranjera y unas 7.000 personas viviendo en asentamientos chabolistas en la provincia, muchas de ellas trabajadoras migrantes sin contrato.
El peor momento. España atraviesa semanas de tensión por la crisis migratoria de Ceuta, desatada tras la entrada masiva de finales de julio. El Gobierno calcula que aún quedan unas 5.000 personas en la ciudad autónoma, cifra que las autoridades locales elevan hasta 9.000. El pasado fin de semana hubo nuevas protestas y el Ejecutivo declaró la situación de interés para la Seguridad Nacional mediante el Real Decreto 681/2026, del 25 de agosto. Ceuta y Melilla encabezan los delitos de violencia de género y hay algunos temores en plena vuelta al cole.
Sin embargo, Tabula Rasa no investiga a personas recién llegadas ni guarda relación con Ceuta: persigue a organizaciones que estafan tanto a propietarios como a extranjeros ya asentados, muchos de ellos víctimas de un mercado negro que se aprovecha de su necesidad. Ninguna fuente policial atribuye responsabilidad penal a quienes pagaron por direcciones falsas; la acusación recae sobre quienes diseñaron y lucraron con el fraude. Y hablamos de una crisis (humanitaria y de derechos), no una invasión. Tratar este suceso como un grito crispado ante el debate migratorio estigmatiza a comunidades enteras por la actuación de unas pocas redes criminales, cuando el verdadero daño lo sufren tanto los vecinos suplantados como los migrantes estafados

articles.title: Delhi govt holds roundtable with startup leaders to strengthen policy
articles.text:
Delhi govt holds roundtable with startup leaders to strengthen policy
The Delhi government aims to support more than 10,000 startups with the potential to generate over 4 lakh jobs
The Delhi government on Sunday held a roundtable with leading startup founders, investors and industry representatives to seek suggestions on the implementation of its Startup and Incubation Policy, 2026, which aims to support more than 10,000 startups and generate over four lakh jobs.
Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, who attended the meeting, said Delhi has the talent, educational institutions, technology capabilities and large consumer market needed to emerge as a major startup and innovation hub.
The roundtable was organised by the Department of Training and Technical Education in collaboration with Youth for Governance at The Lalit in New Delhi.
The meeting was attended by prominent entrepreneurs and investors, including Info Edge founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani, Snapdeal co-founder and Titan Capital founder Kunal Bahl, Swiggy CEO Rohit Kapoor, Urban Company co-founder Abhiraj Singh Bhal, CARS24 founder Vikram Chopra and CashKaro co-founder Swati Bhargava, it stated.
Representatives from companies and startups including Innov8, Veeba, InsuranceDekho, Zypp Electric, Statiq, AstroTalk, Newton School of Technology and Ecosoul also participated in the discussions, the statement read.
The discussions focused on the key provisions, implementation framework and proposed financial support of over Rs 400 crore under the policy, besides measures to create a more supportive environment for startups, according to a statement.
"Delhi has talented youth, strong educational institutions, technological capabilities, a large market and the presence of leading industries, making it a natural hub for startups and innovation," Gupta said.
She said the government's objective was to ensure that young people get support for their ideas and innovations, while startups are able to create employment and contribute to economic growth.
Under the policy, the government plans to establish incubation centres in Delhi University colleges and schools, she said.
Gupta said the government would work with startup founders, investors, industry representatives, educational institutions and young people to make the implementation of the policy more participatory and outcome-oriented.
The chief minister said Delhi's startup ecosystem should go beyond creating businesses and become a foundation for innovation, investment, employment generation and economic growth.

articles.title: Audi A2 e-tron : premier avis à bord de l'électrique qui promet 649 km d'autonomie
articles.text:
Audi la présente comme sa voiture électrique la plus efficiente : 12,8 kWh/100 km et une autonomie pouvant aller jusqu’à 649 km WLTP. La nouvelle A2 e-tron veut reproduire ce qu’a fait son aïeule thermique dans les années 2000, cette fois à la sauce 100 % électrique. En attendant de vérifier cela sur route, Numerama a déjà pu monter à bord de la compacte. Les impressions sont plutôt réjouissantes.
Un hommage à l’A2 de 1999 plutôt bien vu
Visuellement, l’A2 e-tron assume son héritage, et c’est une réussite. La voiture est trapue, ramassée, surtout dans la finition S line qui gonfle les boucliers et noircit les bas de caisse. La signature lumineuse avant reprend les codes des dernières Audi. Mais c’est la poupe qui m’a le plus séduit, avec sa double vitre entrecoupée d’un spoiler, ses feux LED horizontaux et son gros logo central. Le dessin des différentes jantes au catalogue est lui aussi très réussi.
Vous aurez remarqué que les flancs sont dépourvus de poignées de porte. Celles-ci ont été délocalisées au niveau des montants et prennent la forme d’une petite ailette. Elles s’ouvrent à la manière d’un tiroir : le simple fait de tirer la porte vers soi suffit. Ça fonctionne bien, puisque l’on ne sent pas le mécanisme agir.
Et à ce propos, une question me trotte quand même dans la tête : où est le déverrouillage de secours ? Le système semble 100 % électrique, sans redondance mécanique visible. Étonnant en pleine polémique sur ce type de poignées. Audi assure que chaque porte embarque sa propre réserve d’énergie pour garder l’accès au véhicule même en cas de panne électrique.
À bord de l’A2 e-tron : de l’astuce et quelques fausses notes
À l’intérieur, la planche de bord est franchement originale, avec ses buses d’aération verticales. On s’y sent tout de suite bien. Les matériaux sont d’assez bonne facture, et même le textile de la finition d’entrée de gamme est agréable au toucher. Audi habille une bonne partie de l’habitacle d’une surface souple baptisée Softwrap, qui court de la planche de bord jusqu’aux panneaux de porte. Un genre de plastique enduit et grainé utilisé sur les accoudoirs peut dérouter sous les doigts.
Au rayon des bémols, il subsiste quelques plastiques durs peu flatteurs pour une premium, en bas de console centrale et sur les bas de contre-portes. À l’arrière, les passagers de plus d’1,80 m pourront être un peu à l’étroit, mais le toit panoramique vitré en option (1,6 m²) rattrape heureusement la sensation d’espace.
Côté rangements, Audi a soigné les détails avec la présence de deux chargeurs par induction ventilés et magnétiques (MagSafe chez Apple), ainsi qu’un astucieux système de fixation magnétique baptisé Fidlock, permettant d’ajouter des accessoires, comme des porte-gobelets ou des sacs. On en trouve dans la console centrale et dans le coffre.
Justement, ce dernier offre un bon volume de 396 litres (1 336 litres banquette rabattue). Le coffre avant est par contre riquiqui avec ses 13 litres. À peine de quoi loger les câbles de recharge. Dommage.
Face au conducteur, deux écrans se partagent une même dalle incurvée, déjà vue sur les autres électriques de la marque : une instrumentation de 11,9 pouces et un écran tactile de 12,8 pouces. Le système d’info-divertissement s’est montré réactif.
Quelques boutons physiques subsistent, mais l’essentiel passe par des touches à retour haptique, tandis que la climatisation se règle obligatoirement via l’écran central. Il faudra également évaluer l’ergonomie de l’espace pour actionner les palettes de récupération, coincées entre le volant et les commodos.
Jusqu’à 649 km d’autonomie
L’A2 e-tron mise donc tout sur l’efficience. Au programme : prises d’air pilotées, soubassement caréné, jantes profilées. Autant d’optimisations qui ont fait gagner environ 0,9 kWh/100 km selon le constructeur. Quatre niveaux de puissance de 170 à 326 ch et trois capacités de batterie (52 kWh, 61 kWh et 84 kWh) sont proposés. Quand les deux plus petites reposent sur une chimie LFP (lithium-fer-phosphate), la grande batterie passe sur une chimie NMC pour maximiser la densité énergétique, et donc l’autonomie.
C’est la version de 84 kWh et 231 ch qui revendique une autonomie généreuse de 649 km WLTP. Niveau recharge, la marque annonce 183 kW sur borne rapide, ce qui se traduit par un 10 à 80 % en 29 minutes.
Sur les versions à petite batterie, la puissance en pic plafonne respectivement à 100 et 105 kW, pour un même exercice effectué en 24 ou 26 minutes. L’A2 e-tron sait aussi jouer les batteries sur roues grâce à la recharge bidirectionnelle V2L (vehicle-to-load) et V2H (vehicle-to-home).
Un prix d’attaque à 38 600 euros
L’A2 e-tron devient l’entrée de gamme électrique chez Audi. Comptez 38 600 euros pour la finition « de base » (52 kWh, 170 ch), 42 900 euros pour la batterie de 61 kWh, 46 900 euros pour les 84 kWh en 231 ch et 52 000 euros pour la sportive de 326 ch. Les commandes ouvrent à l’automne 2026, les livraisons en décembre.
Notre avis à chaud sur l’Audi A2 e-tron
L’Audi A2 e-tron apporte une vraie fraîcheur sur le marché par son design atypique. Après ce premier contact, elle m’a donné envie d’en prendre le volant, mais les clients vont-ils suivre ? À partir de 38 600 euros, la compacte aux anneaux vient chasser sur les terres de la plus huppée des Renault 5, Mégane E-Tech et de ses cousines techniques Volkswagen ID.3 Neo ou Cupra Born. Il reste à voir si le léger surplus d’autonomie et l’image premium du constructeur suffiront à remplir le carnet de commandes.

articles.title: African startup funding fits $2.10B in 8 months as August surges
articles.text:
Between January and August 2026, African startups raised $2.10 billion across 275 tracked funding deals, slightly edging out the $2.07 billion raised during the same eight-month period in 2025. Out of these 275 transactions, 255 deals disclosed their figures, while 20 startups kept their funding amounts private.
Compared to the $2.07 billion raised across the same eight-month period in 2025, overall funding in 2026 remained virtually flat with a slight 1.4% year-on-year increase. However, month-on-month activity fluctuated significantly, driven by massive spikes in February ($361.7M), June ($334.7M), and August ($438.0M) which surged by 209%, 56%, and 368% respectively over their 2025 monthly baselines.
Top markets and mega-deals
Nigeria leads the continent in capital attraction so far in 2026, pulling in $528.6 million. Benin ranks second with $327.1 million, heavily propelled by Spiro’s massive $215 million debt and equity round in June. Egypt ($322.0 million), South Africa ($248.2 million), and Kenya ($216.6 million) round out the top primary markets.
Capital distribution remains concentrated in a few markets because investors are prioritizing established startups in high-volume, asset-heavy sectors like mobility, e-commerce, and clean energy that offer proven unit economics and large customer bases. Mega-deals driven by these platforms such as Moove’s $250 million Series C and Jumia’s $50 million investment from IFC and Axian represented 57% of all capital raised across Nigeria, Egypt, and regional platforms in August.
August 2026 performance: Moove, e-commerce, and crypto lead $438 million Surge
August 2026 recorded an impressive $438.01 million in total funding, driven by large growth rounds and strategic debt facilities.
- Moove secured a massive $250 million Series C led by Abu Dhabi’s Mubadala, Woven Capital, and Ion Pacific to expand its mobility-fintech operations.
- Jumia raised $50 million in equity backed by the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and Axian.
- Yellow Card completed a $40 million funding round backed by SC Ventures (Standard Chartered), Sony Innovation Fund, Polychain Capital, and Blockchain Capital.
- Moment raised a $22 million Series A from AlphaCode Venture Partners, General Catalyst, MultiChoice, and Canal+.
- Terra Industries secured $18 million to complete its $52 million seed round, backed by 8VC and Silent Ventures.
- Biovac secured a $15 million loan from the African Development Bank (AfDB) for vaccine manufacturing.
- Swvl secured $14.5 million in post-IPO equity led by Coefficient LP and Sofico Holdings.
- Naran raised $10 million in debt and equity from Landel.
- Jem pulled in $8.4 million in Series A funding led by Quona Capital.
- ThriveAgric raised a $3.93 million debt facility.
Undisclosed August rounds
Several startups secured capital in August without publicly disclosing their cheque sizes. These include Yellow (Series C led by Convergence Partners), Flowt (Pre-seed backed by Delta40, Impacc, and Argidius Foundation), Mathesis Analytics (backed by Sewa Capital), Dawa Mkononi (backed by Africa Health Ventures), and Powered by People (backed by BESTSELLER Foundation and Susa Ventures).
Additionally, gender-lens fund Five35 Ventures deployed equity cheques into an array of portfolio startups including Fincart, BuuPass, Daleela, Pricepally, and Malaica.
The early-stage funding squeeze: Grants and non-equity capital step in
While total August top-line numbers jumped to $438 million, the ecosystem’s structural split widened further this month. August saw over 90% of all deployed equity capital concentrate into just two mega-deals (Moove’s $250M Series C and Jumia’s $50M round), while early-stage startups increasingly relied on small government grants and Web3 ecosystem checks under $150,000 to survive.
Early-stage startups face a drastically higher bar than in previous years. Investors no longer underwrite pure potential or user growth; they demand clear evidence of unit economics, customer retention, capital efficiency, and a demonstrable path to revenue. For early-stage founders, this shift means extending runway through leaner burn rates, pursuing non-dilutive debt or grants, and prioritizing early revenue generation over aggressive scale to avoid running out of cash before becoming investable.
As traditional venture capital thins out at the $50,000 to $500,000 level, alternative capital models are stepping up:
- Government grants and fellowships: In August alone, regional government programs like the Edo State Government in Nigeria funded 11 early-stage ventures including Safebox Energy, IVIE, and Zummey Technologies. Simultaneously, the CcHUB and Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship awarded $100,000 grants each to 12 African edtech startups (including TrainDTrainer, Talktu, and Efiwe).
- Web3 ecosystem grants: Ecosystem funds like the Stellar Community Fund backed multiple early-stage African builders in August, including Seevcash ($149,000), Remi ($135,000), and Yolat ($110,000).
- Accelerators and debt: Programs like Cascador’s ScaleUp Accelerator are supporting growth-stage businesses through its $5 million Catalytic Fund, providing local-currency debt and guarantees to help founders navigate the venture winter without suffering heavy equity dilution.
Building resilient, revenue-generating businesses rather than companies built solely to raise the next VC round has become the defining strategy for African tech founders navigating H2 2026.

articles.title: Après la panne mondiale de 2024, CrowdStrike rattrapé par une faille publique
articles.text:
Le 19 juillet 2024, une mise à jour défectueuse de CrowdStrike paralysait 8,5 millions de machines Windows, clouant des avions au sol et perturbant hôpitaux comme chaînes de télévision. Deux ans plus tard, l’éditeur texan revient dans l’actualité pour une tout autre raison : un exploit en libre accès visant Falcon, sa plateforme de protection des entreprises.
FalconFlank, l’exploit qui retourne Falcon contre les PC qu’il protège
Son auteur signe Nightmare Eclipse, un pseudonyme également décliné en Chaotic Eclipse ou MSNightmare, bien connu des équipes de sécurité de Microsoft pour ses publications de failles à répétition. Sa dernière trouvaille, baptisée FalconFlank et rendue publique dans les derniers jours d’août, permettrait une élévation de privilèges en détournant une fonction bien précise de Falcon : la suppression automatique des macros Office malveillantes, ce mécanisme qui inspecte les documents et en retire les codes suspects. Le gardien nettoie, l’attaquant en profite pour passer par la porte qu’il tient ouverte.
La démonstration fonctionnerait sur des systèmes entièrement à jour, Windows 11 25H2 et Windows Server 2025, avec la protection réglée au niveau maximal. Le chercheur en sécurité Kevin Beaumont, qui suit activement le dossier Nightmare Eclipse depuis ses premiers zero-days en avril, affirme avoir vérifié le bon fonctionnement de l’exploit. Aucun identifiant CVE n’a encore été attribué, et CrowdStrike se contente pour l’heure d’un prudent « nous enquêtons activement sur ces affirmations », assorti d’une recommandation : désactiver le réglage Windows de suppression des macros suspectes en attendant. Voilà donc des clients priés de débrancher une protection pour se protéger.
Après Microsoft, le chasseur de failles s’attaque aux gardiens du temple
La cible surprend, car ce chercheur avait jusqu’ici réservé ses munitions à Microsoft (tout en ne mâchant pas ses mots sur l’éditeur de Redmond). Le voilà qui élargit sa chasse aux éditeurs de sécurité eux-mêmes : il a déjà publié HardBreacher contre Kaspersky, PrettyPrague contre Avast et GreenSection contre Nvidia. Son message, revendiqué, pointe des problèmes de qualité logicielle systémiques dans une industrie censée montrer l’exemple.
Un logiciel comme Falcon s’exécute avec des privilèges très élevés, condition nécessaire pour surveiller tout le système. C’est un vigile qui possède les clés de toutes les portes : quiconque parvient à le manipuler transforme sa ronde en visite guidée. Les entreprises équipées, en France comme ailleurs, ont donc un réglage à désactiver, un correctif à guetter et quelques questions à poser à leur fournisseur lors du prochain comité de suivi.

articles.title: Whatsapp ohne Account nutzen: Dieses Feature soll es künftig möglich machen
articles.text:
Whatsapp: So telefonierst du bald mit Personen ohne eigenen Account
Meta will Whatsapp für noch mehr Menschen öffnen. Dafür arbeitet das Unternehmen laut WABetaInfo an mehreren Neuerungen, um die Account-Pflicht für den Messenger etwas zu lockern. Schon seit März 2026 befindet sich ein Feature in Entwicklung, über das Personen in Chats eingeladen werden können, die gar nicht bei Whatsapp angemeldet sind. Sobald sie auf einen Einladungs-Link klicken, können sie als Gast beitreten und über die Webversion des Browsers mit anderen chatten.
Whatsapp lockert Account-Pflicht für Telefonate
Zwar befindet sich diese Neuerung noch in Arbeit und wird vorerst nur mit ersten User:innen getestet, doch geht Meta schon den nächsten Schritt an. Denn künftig sollst du auch mit anderen über Whatsapp telefonieren können, auch wenn sie keinen Account erstellt haben. Laut WABetaInfo soll dabei dieselbe Technik zum Einsatz kommen, wie schon bei den Gästeeinladungen für Text-Chats.
Zunächst müssen Whatsapp-User:innen mit einem Account einen Anruf erstellen. Den dabei generierten Link können sie im Anschluss mit allen Personen teilen, die am Gespräch teilnehmen sollen. Sobald jemand ohne Whatsapp-Account darauf klickt, öffnet sich die Webansicht des Messengers samt Anrufoberfläche. Sobald die Nutzer:innen ohne Account beitreten, müssen sie ihren Namen eingeben. Whatsapp generiert daraufhin einen „Identifier“ im Hintergrund, der für die Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselte Kommunikation mit angemeldeten Whatsapp-User:innen genutzt wird.
Es gibt aber einen Unterschied für diejenigen, die keinen Whatsapp-Account haben. Sie müssen zunächst von den Ersteller:innen des Anrufs zugelassen werden, um beitreten zu können. Normalerweise ist das für Anrufe ein optionales Feature. Bei Nutzer:innen mit Account bleibt das auch so. Für Gäste müssen die Administrator:innen aber immer erst die Genehmigung erteilen. So soll sichergestellt werden, dass nicht einfach jeder mit dem Link beitreten kann.
Der Anruf-Link ist nach der Erstellung zehn Tage in Whatsapp gültig. Der „Raum“ kann dabei jederzeit von allen Teilnehmer:innen betreten und verlassen werden, die schon zugelassen wurden. Administrator:innen können aber auch Teilnehmer:innen wieder entfernen und davon abhalten, erneut beizutreten. Noch arbeitet Meta hinter verschlossenen Türen an der Umsetzung des Whatsapp-Features. Einen Zeitrahmen für den Release gibt es nicht.

articles.title: Razer Launches Clio X Wireless Speaker Head Cushion With THX Spatial Audio
articles.text:
Monday, September 7th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Razer Launches Clio X Wireless Speaker Head Cushion With THX Spatial Audio
Razer, the leading global lifestyle brand for gamers, today announced the Razer Clio X, an essential wireless speaker head cushion that brings rear surround sound to virtually most high-back gaming chair.
Debuting at PAX West 2026 (Sep 4 to Sep 7), the Razer Clio X combines THX Spatial Audio with Razer HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz wireless, bringing premium rear-channel immersion to more gamers than ever before.With immersive sound, wireless freedom, and broad compatibility, the Razer Clio X is more than an accessory - it's what transforms most gaming chair into an enhanced audio experience.
Hear What's Behind You
At the core of the Razer Clio X is an integrated near-field speaker design with dual 38 mm full-range drivers and 55 mm passive radiators, angled directly toward the listener's ears to deliver focused, immersive audio from behind.
Powered by THX Spatial Audio, acoustic widening modes create a broader, more realistic soundstage, bringing greater depth and spatial awareness to games, movies, and music without requiring a headset.
Wireless Freedom, Zero Compromise
Razer Clio X delivers ultra-low-latency wireless audio through Razer HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz, freeing users from console or PC cabling. It can be powered by any USB-C PD 2.0 power bank (not included) for up to 40 hours of wireless use, with actual battery life varying by power bank capacity and usage. At the same time, a built-in USB Type-C cable stores neatly inside the rear cushion pouch for a clean, clutter-free setup.
Designed for broad compatibility, the plush, supportive foam head cushion features an adjustable 30-65 cm nylon strap that fits most high-back gaming and office chairs, making it a comfortable, versatile addition to any setup.
One Rear Speaker, Multiple Ways to Play
The Razer Clio X can be used as a standalone primary speaker for headset-free gaming, movies, and music, or paired in Surround Mode with an existing soundbar or 2.0/2.1 speaker system to create a rear surround audio experience powered by THX Spatial Audio.

Razer Clio X delivers ultra-low-latency wireless audio through Razer HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz, freeing users from console or PC cabling. It can be powered by any USB-C PD 2.0 power bank (not included) for up to 40 hours of wireless use, with actual battery life varying by power bank capacity and usage. At the same time, a built-in USB Type-C cable stores neatly inside the rear cushion pouch for a clean, clutter-free setup.
Designed for broad compatibility, the plush, supportive foam head cushion features an adjustable 30-65 cm nylon strap that fits most high-back gaming and office chairs, making it a comfortable, versatile addition to any setup.
One Rear Speaker, Multiple Ways to Play
The Razer Clio X can be used as a standalone primary speaker for headset-free gaming, movies, and music, or paired in Surround Mode with an existing soundbar or 2.0/2.1 speaker system to create a rear surround audio experience powered by THX Spatial Audio.

articles.title: Molten Ventures raises €203 million to back UK and European growth-stage tech companies | EU-Startups
articles.text:
Molten Ventures, a British VC firm with a 20-year track record, today announces the first close of its Growth Fund at €203 million (£175 million) to invest across key technology sectors including Space, AI, FinTech, Quantum, DeepTech and Hardware.
The British Business Bank has committed €87 million (£75 million) as cornerstone investor. Molten Ventures has committed the remaining €116 million (£100 million) of the first close and will continue to seek additional investors, with the aim of growing the Growth Fund to a target of €407 million (£350 million).
Ben Wilkinson, Chief Executive Officer of Molten Ventures, says: “Securing the British Business Bank as cornerstone investor is a strong endorsement of Molten’s strategy and of the relationship we have built over many years. It also underlines the importance of bringing more long-term institutional capital into venture and Growth, so that ambitious UK and European technology companies have the backing they need to scale.
“Molten has a strong track record in growth investing, with more than 40 growth-profile deals completed and over £700 million invested. The Growth Fund builds on that experience and gives us a dedicated vehicle to support more companies as they scale.”
Molten Ventures’ first close comes can be contrasted with other new capital formation across European technology investment funds in 2026.
EU-Startups has seen comparable vehicles including Barcelona-based Kembara‘s €750 million first close for a DeepTech growth fund, the €500 million Franco-German E2D DefenceTech growth vehicle, Earlybird VC‘s €360 million technology fund, and Paris-based SlateVC‘s €132 million for its climate-focused growth strategy.
The UK alone provides plenty of activity: Mouro Capital, Seedcamp, 2150, Lansdowne Partners and Tapestry VC have also announced funds or closes worth €343 million, €279 million, €210 million, €128.9 million and €70 million respectively.
Together with Molten’s new vehicle, these 2026 announcements represent almost €3 billion in disclosed capital.
EU-Startups has previously covered Molten Ventures as an investor in Tapestry VC‘s Fund III and in UK SpaceTech company SatVu.
“There is no shortage of exceptional founders or technology businesses in the UK and Europe; what they too often lack is sufficient growth capital to help them become global leaders. This Fund gives Molten greater firepower to back our highest-conviction companies at Series B and beyond, build meaningful ownership positions and channel capital into the next generation of growth.
“Alongside our other strategies, including Molten Secondaries, the Growth Fund will strengthen our ability to connect long-term capital with companies that are shaping the future,” adds Ben.
Originally founded in 2006 as Esprit Capital, the firm later became Draper Esprit in 2015 before rebranding to Molten Ventures in November 2021. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Molten Ventures gives public market investors access to their portfolio of privately held technology businesses.
Since 2016, Molten has reportedly deployed more than €1.1 billion (£1 billion) of capital and realised more than €931 million (£800 million) in proceeds from its investments. Across the Group, Molten manages over €2.3 billion (£2 billion) in AUM.
The fund is a continuation of Molten’s existing investment strategy of Series B+ investments, with a track record of more than 40 deals and over €814 million (£700 million) invested in the past ten years. The fund offers private institutional capital the opportunity to invest at scale through a private fund structure, while benefiting from the public vehicle’s platform and governance.
Robert Greenwood, Senior Director, Funds at British Business Bank, says: “To create deeper pools of late-stage capital for breakthrough technologies, we are helping UK tech investors to launch new growth funds. This commitment is the latest example of that strategy.
“Molten Ventures is one of the UK’s leading growth investors, with a strong track record of backing fast-growing technology businesses. This fund will help the next generation of tech entrepreneurs scale faster and build global companies from the UK.”
The Growth Fund is a key part of Molten’s strategy to build scale through additional third-party capital under management. As a dedicated source of institutional funding alongside Molten’s listed platform, it will enable the Company to increase the volume of Series B+ investment rounds in high-growth UK and European technology companies as they move from early growth into later stage scale-ups.
The VC outlines this as a critical funding gap in the UK and European market for high growth innovative technology businesses and one where they see an opportunity to deliver strong returns.
The Growth Fund will invest in companies at the forefront of innovation across key technology sectors including Space, AI, FinTech, Quantum, DeepTech and Hardware, providing them with the liquidity they need to compete globally, while giving Molten greater ability to build meaningful ownership positions in high-conviction businesses.
The British Business Bank has been an investor in Molten’s listed platform since 2018 and has co-invested alongside Molten in several high-growth UK technology companies, including SatVu, IMU Biosciences, Thought Machine and Paragraf.

articles.title: Samsung mata dos apps muy locas que seguro nunca usaste (ni vas a extrañar)
articles.text:
Samsung tiene uno de los catálogos de apps más amplios dentro del ecosistema Android. Los móviles Galaxy cuentan con una gran cantidad de soluciones propias que se complementan con las disponibles en todos los dispositivos con el sistema operativo de Google. Sin embargo, no todas han logrado la aceptación o popularidad esperada, y la empresa coreana ha decidido deshacerse de dos de ellas.
Puntualmente, Samsung ha anunciado que a finales de año discontinuará las apps AR Doodle y Quick Measure. Se trata de dos herramientas que sacaban provecho de la cámara y sensores de los smartphones de la marca, como también de la tecnología de realidad aumentada.
Si nunca usaste AR Doodle o Quick Measure, no te preocupes: no eres el único. Estamos hablando de apps que Samsung distribuía a través de la Galaxy Store, su propia tienda, y de las que muchos desconocían su existencia. Desde la compañía no han brindado detalles sobre la decisión. No obstante, es lógico pensar que no tenía un caudal de uso que ameritara mantener el soporte.
El anuncio de la eliminación de estas apps se realizó en la más reciente actualización que lanzó Samsung. En la página dedicada a cada una de ellas en la Galaxy Store, la compañía mencionó su discontinuación a partir del próximo 31 de diciembre. Esto significa que desde el 1 de enero de 2027 ya no se podrán descargar, ni tampoco se brindarán mejoras o nuevas funciones en futuras versiones de One UI.
Samsung mata AR Doodle y Quick Measure, dos de sus apps de realidad aumentada
Tanto AR Doodle como Quick Measure parecen haber nacido como experimentos dentro del laboratorio de apps de Samsung. Son propuestas totalmente de nicho que tal vez han servido para demostrar la tecnología incorporada en los móviles de la marca, pero cuya utilidad real en la vida cotidiana ha sido prácticamente nula.
En el caso de AR Doodle, se trata de una utilidad que permite realizar dibujos tridimensionales sobre un fondo real. Una aplicación llamativa y que sacaba especial provecho del S Pen en los Galaxy S Ultra. Por su parte, Quick Measure se presentaba como una alternativa a la tradicional cinta métrica, pues podía medir las dimensiones de prácticamente cualquier elemento u objeto con solo apuntarle la cámara del móvil.
Según menciona Samsung, quienes tengan estas apps instaladas en sus móviles, podrán seguir usándolas tras la fecha de discontinuación. Sin embargo, algunas características puede que ya no funcionen de la manera deseada. Y si por algún motivo quieres probarlas antes de que dejen de estar disponibles, tienes que apresurarte para descargarlas mientras todavía están en el catálogo de la Galaxy Store.
AR Doodle y Quick Measure no son las primeras apps que Samsung elimina de su catálogo. Meses atrás, la compañía optó por eliminar una herramienta histórica de sus móviles como lo fue la plataforma Mensajes. Claro que en este caso fue para darle cabida a una solución por defecto que ya es el estándar de Android: la app Mensajes de Google.

articles.title: Fone de ouvido Anker Soundcore: 10 modelos para comprar em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Fone de ouvido Anker Soundcore: 10 modelos para comprar em 2026
Selecionamos os melhores fones de ouvido Soundcore da Anker; veja modelos com cancelamento de ruído, para esportes, headphones e até fones para dormir
O portfólio de fones de ouvido Anker reúne modelos para diferentes públicos e orçamentos. Fones Soundcore mais básicos não costumam trazer cancelamento ativo de ruído e focam na autonomia da bateria. Já modelos mais avançados têm ANC e especificações avançadas, como suporte a áudios de alta resolução.
Para te ajudar na escolha, o Tecnoblog selecionou 10 opções de fone de ouvido Anker Soundcore para comprar em 2026. Confira prós e contras de cada modelo antes de decidir qual é o melhor para seu dia a dia.
O Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 NC é um fone intra-auricular projetado para áudios imersivos com menos interferências de sons externos. Sua cavidade acústica reduz as vozes humanas ao redor, enquanto o cancelamento ativo de ruído (ANC) adaptativo 3.0 ajusta o ANC a cada 0,3 s a fim de otimizar o isolamento.
A certificação de alta resolução sem fio (Hi-Res Audio Wireless) também oferece uma experiência sonora mais envolvente e detalhada em conexões Bluetooth 5.4. Já o suporte ao Dolby Audio otimiza a amplitude e clareza dos áudios.
Com driver de 9,2 mm, os fones pesam 4,6 g cada e ainda suportam multiponto mesmo com o LDAC ativado. A autonomia com ANC fica em 8h, mas pode chegar a 48h no modo transparência e com as recargas do estojo.
O fone também inclui versões Pro e Pro Max, que são mais caras, mas trazem diferenciais como Dolby Atmos, versão superior de ANC e mais microfones. No entanto, a versão base já oferece uma ótima experiência para a maioria dos usuários, representando melhor custo-benefício.
Codecs suportados: SBC, AAC e LDAC
O Anker Soundcore Q31i tem design over-ear e drivers personalizados de 40 mm que atingem até 98 dB. O periférico (265 g) possui cancelamento ativo de ruído adaptativo de 37 dB, com quatro microfones para reduzir barulhos externos em tempo real.
A compatibilidade com áudio de alta resolução é um dos diferenciais, funcionando tanto no modo wireless (Bluetooth 6.0) quanto no modo cabeado. Também há suporte para recursos de inteligência artificial, como tradução em tempo real e redução de ruído para microfone em chamadas.
A autonomia da bateria se destaca, chegando a 50 horas (com ANC) e até 80 horas (sem ANC). Em contrapartida, o formato é over-ear e não há certificação IP contra água e poeira.
O Anker Soundcore Space One também é um fone over-ear com driver de 40 mm com ANC adaptativo. O sistema promete reduzir o ruído em até 98% e tem calibração automática para minimizar barulhos externos mesmo sem isolamento perfeito ao redor dos ouvidos.
Há algumas similaridades em relação ao modelo Q31i, como Hi-Res Audio com ou sem fio e suporte ao codec LDAC. Por outro lado, o Space One (265 g) foca em conforto ao trazer conchas com rotação de 8º para mais adaptabilidade de uso.
A bateria tem autonomia de até 40 horas com ANC ligado, mas pode chegar a 55 horas sem o cancelamento de ruído. Demais especificações incluem Bluetooth 5.3 e três microfones com IA para chamadas.
O fone intra-auricular Anker Soundcore P31i chega com otimizações interessantes em relação à geração anterior: o ANC adaptativo de 52 dB está três vezes mais potente para evitar barulhos externos que podem quebrar a imersão, e os drivers de 11 mm revestidos em titânio oferecem graves duas vezes mais profundos.
A compatibilidade com áudios de alta resolução sem fio garante sons mais detalhados em pareamento com Bluetooth 6.1. Já a autonomia da bateria chega a 10h (com ANC desativado), embora caia para 8h com o cancelamento de ruído ativado.
Os fones Soundcore P31i ainda têm proteção contra suor e chuvas mais leves, garantida pelo selo IP55.
O Anker Soundcore Space 2 é uma ótima opção de over-ear para viajantes. Isso porque o fone conta com ANC adaptativo 3.0 projetado para lidar com barulhos de baixa frequência, como os ruídos de motores a jato. Seu design dobrável e peso de 264 g também facilitam a portabilidade em viagens.
Assim como o modelo antecessor, o Soundcore Space 2 tem driver de 40 mm e é compatível com áudio de alta resolução no modo com ou sem fio (via conexão Bluetooth 6.1). Ele também suporta ferramentas de IA a partir do app Soundcore.
A autonomia de bateria é um dos destaques, podendo durar 50 horas (com ANC) ou até 70 horas (sem ANC). Não há proteção IP e, por isso, é bom mantê-lo longe da água e poeira.
O Anker Soundcore Sport X20 é um fone intra-auricular leve (6,62 g cada) e voltado para esportistas. O periférico chega com cancelamento ativo de ruído adaptativo para minimizar barulhos externos que podem atrapalhar seus treinos.
Os drivers dinâmicos de 11 mm são empoderados pela tecnologia BassUp para impulsionar os graves. Já as hastes ajustáveis oferecem melhor encaixe diante das atividades físicas, apesar de não serem removíveis.
A bateria dura 7 horas (com ANC), mas você pode estender a autonomia para até 28 horas ao usar as recargas do estojo. A proteção IP68 é outro ponto positivo, suportando mergulhos de até 1,5 m por 30 minutos.
Codecs suportados: SBC e AAC
O Anker Soundcore AeroClip é um modelo open-ear. Seu design pode ser uma alternativa para quem não gosta de fones intra-auriculares ou over-ear. No entanto, o formato impede isolamentos mais eficientes do ambiente externo e, por isso, ele não conta com cancelamento ativo de ruído.
Em compensação, o fone traz drivers dinâmicos de 12 mm com a tecnologia Virtual Bass para graves mais presentes. E a certificação Hi-Res Audio Wireless garante qualidade mais elevada de som em conexões Bluetooth 5.4.
A proteção IP55 oferece resistência contra suor leve e chuva fraca. A bateria alcança uma autonomia de 8 horas, que pode chegar a 32 horas com as recargas do estojo.
O Anker Soundcore AeroFit 2 também é um fone over-ear e, por isso, não possui cancelamento ativo de ruído. Seu design traz ganchos ajustáveis similares ao do Sport X20, embora a área do alto-falante fique sobre a orelha — sem entrar nos canais auditivos.
O fone (10 g cada) possui drivers de 20 mm com tecnologia BassTurbo para amplificar os graves da música. Ele também suporta o codec LDAC e áudios de alta resolução sem fio, com conexões Bluetooth 5.4.
São 10 horas de autonomia com uma única carga, mas a case (compatível com carregamento sem fio) oferece recargas para estender a duração até 42 horas. E o selo IP55 garante proteção contra chuvas leves e suor.
O Anker Soundcore Sleep A30 é um fone intra-auricular recomendado para uma noite de sono mais tranquila. Ele tem um sistema triplo de redução de ruído para atuar como substituto dos tampões de orelha, mas com o benefício de reproduzir músicas.
O periférico foca em leveza (apenas 3 g cada) e design 3D ergonômico para mais conforto durante o descanso. Por isso, não conta com recursos como áudio de alta resolução e conexão multiponto para o Bluetooth 5.3.
Outro destaque interessante é que o fone consegue detectar o sono e pausar a reprodução, garantindo mais autonomia para a bateria, que dura até 9 horas.
O Anker Soundcore P20i é um fone intra-auricular básico para usuários menos exigentes. São apenas dois microfones para chamadas e não há suporte para cancelamento ativo de ruído.
O fone também traz um driver de 10 mm, e oferece 22 predefinições de equalização com o aplicativo para smartphone. Em contrapartida, ele não é compatível com multiponto e nem com áudios de alta resolução.
Ao menos, o modelo tem proteção IPX5 contra respingos e jatos d’água de baixa pressão. A duração da bateria alcança 10h30 e chega a 30h com as recargas do estojo.
Codecs suportados: não informado
Para escolher o melhor fone Anker, analise quais modelos oferecem especificações compatíveis com seu perfil de uso e orçamento. Vale considerar aspectos como:
O Anker Soundcore Sport X20 é o melhor fone para corrida e exercícios da lista. Ele tem ANC adaptativo para reduzir ruídos externos que podem atrapalhar o treino, além de ganchos ajustáveis para reforçar o encaixe. E o fone ainda suporta mergulhos devido à proteção IP68.
A linha P da Anker Soundcore reúne fones intra-auriculares, com ponteiras de silicone que entram no canal auditivo. O portfólio oferece tanto modelos padrão quanto versões mais básicas.
Já a linha Q engloba os fones de ouvido over-ear, com design de headphones. Os modelos possuem conchas que envolvem a orelha para otimizar o isolamento passivo, sendo maiores e mais pesados que os fones da linha P.
Sim. Os fones de ouvido Soundcore são renomados na indústria global, mesmo que a marca tenha pouco mais de 10 anos de história. Prova disso é que a empresa ficou em sexto lugar no ranking global de faturamento do mercado de fones wireless em 2025.
Sim. A Anker é uma empresa chinesa de hardware fundada em 2011, presente em mais de 147 países. Apesar do foco central em energia, a companhia atua no mercado de áudio sob a marca Soundcore, com portfólio amplo de fones de ouvido.
A JBL foi fundada em 1946 e possui maior tradição no mercado de áudio que a Anker, nascida em 2014. No entanto, o rótulo de “melhor marca” varia de pessoa para pessoa, de acordo com a variedade do portfólio e experiências individuais.
Mais importante que definir qual é a melhor marca é analisar qual das empresas oferece o fone mais adequado para você. A JBL é conhecida pela assinatura sonora encorpada, com graves presentes e ótima durabilidade, enquanto a Anker se destaca ao trazer um preço mais acessível junto a recursos avançados, resultando em um melhor custo-benefício para o usuário comum.

articles.title: Audi’s new A2 E-tron is its most affordable and efficient EV yet
articles.text:
When shopping for an electric vehicle, affordability is becoming a more common trait. But affordable and energy efficient is truly a rare breed. Often you have to sacrifice one for the other. Want something affordable? Great, here’s a range loser. Want something that goes the distance? Be ready to pay the price.
Audi’s new A2 E-tron is its most affordable and efficient EV yet
Unfortunately it won’t be making it’s way to North America any time soon.
Surprisingly, here comes Audi to split the difference. The German automaker’s new A2 E-tron compact crossover is inexpensive, starting at just £32,200 (about $45,000). And it absolutely impresses with an ultra low drag coefficient and a range of battery and drivetrain options that, when configured correctly, can produce a range of up to 401 miles.
Unfortunately for us Yanks, this rear-wheel drive compact car is just for the European market for now. But perhaps Audi will eventually see the error of its ways, or Americans will get their heads out of their tailpipes long enough to see the real advantages of a highly efficient, compact EV with an Audi badge.
Efficient is often synonymous with aerodynamic, and the A2 E-tron certainly confirms that. Flush door handles, cool air intakes, a fully enclosed underbody, and gap reducers around the wheel arches help reduce the drag coefficient down to 0.24, a first for Audi. Another first is bidirectional charging, which will help support vehicle-t0-load via an outlet in the trunk, or vehicle-to-home with the right compatible DC wall box.
With the right motor and battery setup, the A2 E-tron consumes just 12.8 kWh per 62 miles (100 km), while the real mile-eater of the lineup manages up to 401 miles (645 km) on the European WLTP cycle. Inside, the A2 E-tron features a standard curved MMI panoramic display that combines an 11.9 inch digital gauge cluster with a 12.8 inch center touch screen.
There’s also plenty of clever storage thanks to a Fidlock magnetic fastening system that allows owners to click things like cupholders and charging cable bags into dedicated points around the cabin and trunk. Cyclists may be familiar with the tech that can keep their water bottles attached to their bike without a cage, but Audi says this is the first time it’s making an appearance in a production car.
While Audi gave up on its EVs-or-bust pledge last year, the automaker is leaving the door open for a mix of gas, hybrid, and electrification. The A2 may not be appearing alongside its brethren like the impressive S6 Sportback E-tron at the dealership anytime soon, but nothing is set in stone.

articles.title: 'Absolutely amazing time to be a PC gamer': modders are solving Nvidia DLSS 5's biggest problems and the gaming community is stoked
articles.text:
Modders have solved Nvidia DLSS 5's two biggest issues — boosting performance massively, and bringing it to more games — but I wouldn't risk doing either
Meet Swapper and Autopilot
- More mods are out for DLSS 5
- They allow for the tech to be easily used with many more PC games
- One of these mods also alters the way in which DLSS 5 is applied to improve performance considerably — at a cost
As you've no doubt seen, modders have been having a field day messing about with Nvidia's DLSS 5, and the latest experiments include a trick to boost performance in a big way, and a method of easily running the tech in a lot more games.
Let's start with the latter, which as TweakTown reports is the DLSS 5 Swapper app which appeared on GitHub courtesy of developer Rakan Alkhaldi.
This takes the pain out of having to manually fudge DLSS 5 to work in unsupported games by automating the process, adding all the required files in the blink of an eye. You just drag and drop the game folder into the app, and it takes care of everything from there.
Swapper can even detect games on the PC it's installed on which can have DLSS 5 modded in. Not every game is supported, of course, but plenty are — and any given title doesn't necessarily have to have DLSS support at all, in any form (this is achieved via another community mod called DLSS 5 Feeder which is included with Swapper).
A similar tool, DLSS 5 Autopilot, published by 'Kizzuwatnaa' and also on Github, offers one-click DLSS 5 setup (via Feeder) along with an additional trick in the form of the 'neural upstream' add-on (from 'matiasLombo'). This runs the neural rendering (AI) process before the DLSS upscaling happens.
Normally, the AI polishing that DLSS 5 applies is performed as the last step of the rendering process to the upscaled final frame, but if you choose this option with Autopilot, it's happening earlier in the chain of events.
Based on experiments detailed on Reddit (posted by ToxicFatee), this makes a major difference to performance. The Redditor has an RTX 4080, and ran Assassin's Creed Shadows at 4K which went from 63 frames per second (fps) to 31fps with DLSS 5, but it was around 50fps with the neural upstream take on DLSS 5. That's a 20% loss, and a far more palatable hit on the frame rate rather than it being cut in half.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Others have aired similar results on Reddit, and there's plenty of excitement about what's being achieved with this mod (and the automated implementation of DLSS 5 across all manner of games). As one Redditor put it: "Absolutely amazing time to be a PC gamer."
Analysis: tread carefully with unofficial mods
All these latest developments with modding are great to see, but for me, it ends at just seeing this progress. By which I mean I wouldn't advise jumping in and installing these kinds of mods – as wonderful as they seem – and I'm content to merely observe, and see the frame rates and visual results, that others are getting. And we aren't short of these observations of late.
Why do I take that view? Well, for starters, I'm not keen on installing third-party software from unknown sources as a rule, because of the concerns around security that this involves. Granted, these are open-source tools (so can be checked over), and I'm sure they're on the proverbial level; but nevertheless, I'd still rather be careful around the risks of viruses and the like.
The second note of caution here pertains to the idea of messing with the rendering pipeline in terms of having DLSS 5 applied earlier in the process (with the Autopilot mod). This will likely involve image degradation or artifacts to some extent — or generally messing with the graphics more than Team Green intended — and I'm sure if this really was a genuinely better way of doing things, Nvidia would've used this route itself. As per observations on Reddit, there does appear to be a quality trade-off for the improved performance here.
All that said, perhaps there will be some kind of official option along these 'performance or quality' lines in the future, as some gamers are already hoping. However, DLSS 5 is, for now, officially designed to work with just one supported title, NBA 2K27, and it does an excellent job with that basketball game.

articles.title: Anycubic Photon P1 MAX review: bigger, better, and tech-packed
articles.text:
Tom's Hardware Verdict
Anycubic’s Photon P1 MAX is the latest large resin printer, with new tech alongside its little brother, the P1. It sports a heated vat, Wave Release Technology, and a large, locking build plate and vat.
Pros
- +Wave Release film
- +Heated vat
- +Large build plate
Cons
- -No auto-refill system
- -AI features can be a little touchy
- -Build plate level system is odd
Why you can trust Tom's Hardware
Anycubic’s newest Photon P1 was released a few months ago, and now it’s time for its bigger brother to step into the resin printing spotlight. Replacing the current Mono M7 Max, the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX packs in some new tech, along with a larger build volume.
Anycubic is showing off its new refined look for resin printing here – sleek, simple, and user- friendly. The Photon P1 Max has the same look and feel as the P1. However, the firmware on the machine we are testing was still in its early stages. With a few bugs, it still works as it should.
The Anycubic P1 MAX is currently on a presale on Anycubic's website for $1,103.00. After the presale, the P1 MAX will go up to $1,149, which isn’t a significant price increase. With all the tech packed into this printer and its simple, sleek design, it’s a great addition to any 3D printer’s workshop and lands a spot on our best resin printers list.
Specifications: Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
| Build Volume | 285.5 x 214 x 300 mm (11.2 x 8.4 x 11.8 inches) | 
| LCD Screen | 1-inch 12K monochrome | 
| Light Source | COB (Chip-on-board) + Reflector +Aspherical Fresnel Lens | 
| X/Y Axis Resolution | 24.8 x 24.8μm | 
| Normal Exposure Time | 2.0 seconds | 
| Interface | 4.5-inch resistive touchscreen | 
| Connectivity | USB, Wi-Fi | 
| Machine Footprint | 430 x 414 x 625 mm (16.9 x 16.2 x 24.6 inches) | 
| Machine Weight | 23.1kg (50.9 lbs) | 
| Release Date | July 22, 2026 | 
| MSRP | $1,103 | 
Included in the Box: Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The Anycubic P1 Max ships with the standard resin printer starter accessories. This includes a Metal scraper, a set of Allen keys, a user manual, a USB drive, a power cord, plus a wipe for the inside of the hood and a plastic scraper.
The USB drive comes pre-loaded with Anycubic’s Photon Workshop Slicer, test files, and a digital manual.
On the back of the printer is a rubber grommet for those who want to add a vent to the back of the printer for fume extraction. No hose is provided with this printer, so you will need to source one that fits to make it usable.
Printing Safety with Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The Anycubic Photon P1 MAX requires the same safety precautions as any other resin printer. Uncured resin is dangerous, and the solvents used to clean your prints can be irritating to skin or cause sensitivity issues over time. Use gloves and safety glasses when pouring resin and handling uncured prints.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Make sure the room you use your resin printer in is well-ventilated to avoid inhaling fumes. Spilled resin should be immediately cleaned up with 99% isopropyl alcohol. After printing, make sure to wipe down your printer and bottles to remove smudges of uncured resin. Always keep your resin tightly sealed and safely stored out of reach of pets and children.
Assembling the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The Anycubic P1 MAX comes fully assembled out of the box. You’ll just need to remove the packing material from the build plate area and peel the screen protectors and labels off the printer and FEP Film.
If you choose any add-ons, such as the perforated build plate, they will be supplied in separate boxes.
Calibrating the Build Plate on the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The P1 MAX, just like the smaller P1, has the same assist features for leveling. You can choose to have the auto-leveling feature on at all times, which I do recommend, but there are times when it’s a good idea to check and make sure all is good after printing for a while. Personally, with these new printers, I tend to check the level right after the first test print to make sure everything is leveled properly.
I am still humbled by the fact that this printer has a pressure system to level the printer. It’s such a nice feature to have. That said, our review unit seems to have a firmware glitch. It levels the build plate, then raises the build plate off the screen about 100 mm. Then you adjust the screws and do it again to get the proper level. It’s not that bad, honestly. You just need to make sure you give it a little turn and go and adjust from there. Hopefully, Anycubic will patch this to make it work just like the smaller P1, where you adjust while the plate is against the screen, as it should be.
Design of the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The Anycubic P1 MAX shares the same exterior and interior design as the smaller P1, which is polished and professional-looking. Anycubic has stepped up its game significantly on the design front, and I’m here for it. Normally, we see cutbacks on newer printers to make them more affordable for the end user, and that's all fine and dandy, but there is something about a nice, weighted printer that gives you that feel of quality over quantity.
The Locking System for the build plate is one of the better ones out there – no longer are you worrying about unscrewing the normal screw like in the past with resin printers. This has a flip-up / down locking system that is nice and chunky, a big plus. The same follows with the vat, which features a slide-in / out locking system that gets rid of the old screws. This is a nice upgrade, because you no longer have to worry about losing screws or getting resin spilled inside the screw holes when swapping vats.
The touch screen is just your standard 4.5-inch panel, but it was also nice and responsive in our testing. Handles on the sides of the printer make it easy to move around if needed, as well.
The P1 MAX has a heated vat that is constantly being maintained at a precise 35 degrees Celsius (95 F). Previous Anycubic resin owners have struggled with printers only initially heating up and then cutting off after that. That is no longer the case here.
The vat also features a drop tray for your build plate, which makes resin cleanup much easier. One thing you won't have to worry about much is the vat capacity: This Vat holds up to 1900ML(1.9L) of resin, which is plenty for any print task.
The most unique feature on the P1 MAX is the Wave Release technology. Anycubic decided to put a special screen cover over the LCD to help ease the release of all prints, and it works wonderfully. This tech keeps air bubbles from being trapped between the FEP Film and the screen, making the peel force smooth like butter.
Slicer compatibility with the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
The Anycubic Photon P1 MAX comes with Anycubic’s Photon Workshop Slicer pre-loaded onto the USB drive. It’s generally very user-friendly and works very well with prints. You select your resin, add your supports, and slice. Send the file to your printer, and you're done. For those who are not fans of having multiple slicers on their system, the good news is that both Chitubox and Lychee support the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX.
Sample Prints on the Anycubic Photon P1 MAX
Using Anycubic Standard Resin in Gray, I wanted to print out some models for a co-worker who is a big Diablo fan. Searching around Makerworld, I came across this figure of Tyrael, and this model by FotisMint was already split into pieces for easier printing. I brought it into the slicer, angled the print, added some automatic medium supports, hit slice, and sent it off to the printer via WIFI. This model printed in 7 hours and 24 minutes at 0.050mm layer height. Taking 254ml of resin, it cost a little over $5 to print. A normal figure like this would be roughly between $25-$80. That’s quite the savings, even adding in the cost of paint.
Adding another print from the Diablo series, I decided to print the Lord of Terror from Makerworld as well. This print I scaled up a bit to make it more boss-like.
This was printed with a mix of Anycubic’s standard gray and white. It printed in 14 hours and 15 minutes, using 1106ML(1.1kg) of resin.
For the last test print, I wanted to do something different. A few years ago, I saw a print for a Pokémon Cubone mask for a dog. So to MakerWorld I went, searching for one that I could print easily, and I found one. It was a two-part mask with little pegs to clip them together. This is nice in part, because if one side of the mask breaks, you can just reprint it. This was sized for a smaller dog right off the bat, so I supported the print and sent it to the printer.
It printed in six hours and five minutes and used 519 ml of resin. I printed this in standard Anycubic gray resin.
Washing and Curing Your Prints PSA
Before you can admire your prints, you’ll need to wash them with isopropyl alcohol and cure them with a UV light. I like to give prints a 30-second hand rinse in a container of 95% Isopropyl alcohol, then a 2-minute rinse in the Anycubic Wash and Cure, which is sold separately and retails for $249 at Anycubic.com.
Completely dry the print with a hair dryer on cool – IPA left on the print will turn white. You can also let the print air dry in a place away from sunlight.
Supports are easier to remove before curing because they are softer. Clip the supports off with side cutters and use tweezers to remove stubborn supports. Remember to always wear gloves while handling uncured prints.
Then place the print in a UV curing station for 15 minutes, or outside in bright sunlight for a few hours.
Your IPA should never be flushed down the drain, especially after being contaminated with uncured resin. Instead, keep using the resin until it’s too dirty, then leave the container open to evaporate. The remaining sludge can be cured with UV light or the sun before being thrown away.
Supports should also be cured before being thrown away.
Bottom Line
The Anycubic Photon P1 MAX is packed with tech and features that are handy for novices and experienced printers alike. It’s easy to use and straightforward to set up. The touchscreen walks you through every aspect to get it started. Anycubic really took user suggestions on this printer and implemented them with precision. If you're new to resin printing and looking for a simple, easy-to-use, and helpful resin printer with a larger volume, this one should be on your short list.
At its current price of $1,103, it’s also a great value. And if you miss the presale window, the $1,149 standard price isn’t a big jump. You can also buy it at Amazon for only $899, if you avail of the $230 coupon. It has features to make sure your print comes out as expected, a heated vat for those who print in cold climates, and the build plate size is a home run in this price range. If you're not looking to print large-size models, the P1 is a great alternative and is currently on sale for only $499.
Matt Farmer is a 3d printing enthusiast since 2018, content creator and occasional contributor to Tom's Hardware. Specializing in resin 3D printing, he enjoys teaching people how to work with resin printers, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with new content creators.

articles.title: OpenAI: UE investiga agentes de IA que invadiram site alemão
articles.text:
A União Europeia informou nesta segunda-feira (7) que está investigando um incidente envolvendo milhares de agentes autônomos de inteligência artificial (IA) da OpenAI. Os sistemas teriam desobedecido às instruções recebidas e ocupado um site alemão na semana passada.
Os agentes deixaram cerca de 18 mil mensagens na DSEwiki, uma plataforma em alemão voltada a programadores e aberta à edição dos usuários. Segundo uma pesquisa divulgada na sexta-feira, os sistemas usaram o espaço para trocar respostas de testes e compartilhar métodos para contornar as barreiras digitais criadas para limitar suas ações.
UE recebeu relatório sobre o incidente
Thomas Regnier, porta-voz digital do bloco europeu, confirmou que a União Europeia está ciente do caso e recebeu um relatório sobre o incidente. “Estamos investigando, mas permanecemos, de qualquer forma, em contato muito próximo com a empresa”, afirmou Regnier a jornalistas.
O porta-voz também disse que o episódio ocorre em um contexto de diversas perdas de controle envolvendo sistemas de IA. Segundo ele, a União Europeia considera o assunto de extrema importância e acompanha a situação de perto.
As regras de inteligência artificial do bloco determinam que os provedores avaliem e reduzam os riscos relacionados aos seus sistemas. Desde agosto, os reguladores europeus também têm autoridade para aplicar multas em casos de violações.
OpenAI já havia relatado outro caso
O episódio ocorre depois de a OpenAI informar, em julho, que dois de seus modelos haviam escapado de um ambiente de testes isolado e conseguido acessar a internet.
Na ocasião, segundo a empresa, os modelos encontraram e atacaram o Hugging Face, plataforma utilizada por desenvolvedores de inteligência artificial para armazenar e compartilhar código.
No caso mais recente, os agentes envolvidos são descritos como programas de IA capazes de executar tarefas de forma independente, sem que uma pessoa precise orientar cada etapa de suas ações.
A investigação da União Europeia ocorre enquanto o bloco acompanha os riscos associados à perda de controle sobre sistemas autônomos e mantém contato com a OpenAI sobre o incidente.
Ana Figueiredo é repórter de tecnologia do Olhar Digital. É formada em jornalismo pela Universidade Federal de Uberlândia (UFU).

articles.title: French Days : le Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 256 Go passe sous les 600€ chez Darty
articles.text:
Les French Days font tomber le Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge à 599 € chez Darty, un tarif qui n'a plus grand-chose à voir avec ses 1 252 € affichés hors promotion. Reste à savoir si ce smartphone très fin mérite votre attention à ce prix, et surtout à qui il convient vraiment.
Lancé à 1 249 € en mai 2025, le Galaxy S25 Edge traînait un reproche que notre test Clubic avait clairement identifié : un tarif difficile à justifier. Pendant les French Days, Darty ramène la version 256 Go à 599 €, soit 653 € de moins que le prix catalogue du marchand, et l'équation change totalement de nature.
Ce bon plan concerne surtout celles et ceux qui cherchent un smartphone haut de gamme compact à transporter, avec un écran de grande taille, sans monter à plus de 1 000 €. Les gros consommateurs de batterie, eux, devront regarder cette offre avec plus de recul.
Voici le Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 256 Go à 599€ au lieu de 1 252€ chez Darty !
Pourquoi choisir le Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge ?
- Un écart de prix considérable : 599 € au lieu de 1 252 €, soit 653 € d'économie sur le prix affiché par Darty.
- Un format vraiment à part : 5,8 mm d'épaisseur et 163 g sur la balance, pour une dalle de 6,7 pouces.
- Une base technique haut de gamme : Snapdragon 8 Elite, 12 Go de mémoire vive, 256 Go de stockage et sept ans de mises à jour.
Un smartphone pensé pour se faire oublier au quotidien
Prendre le Galaxy S25 Edge en main provoque toujours le même effet de surprise. Avec 5,8 mm d'épaisseur et un châssis en titane certifié IP68, il glisse dans une poche de veste ou de pantalon sans la déformer, ce qui reste rare sur un modèle doté d'un écran de 6,7 pouces. Cette dalle Dynamic AMOLED 2X en définition QHD+ et 120 Hz a d'ailleurs obtenu la note de 9 sur 10 dans notre test Clubic, tout comme la partie photo.
Côté image, le capteur principal de 200 Mpx assure aussi bien en photo qu'en vidéo, épaulé par un ultra grand-angle de 12 Mpx. Le Snapdragon 8 Elite et les 12 Go de mémoire vive suivent sans difficulté la bureautique mobile, les réseaux sociaux, la navigation et les fonctions Galaxy AI, avec sept ans de mises à jour promises par Samsung.
À 599 €, un positionnement enfin cohérent face à la concurrence
À ce niveau de prix, le S25 Edge ne se compare plus aux modèles Ultra mais à des références comme le Galaxy S25 classique ou les Pixel de milieu de gamme, face auxquels il apporte une finition et une finesse sans équivalent. En revanche, il ne propose ni téléobjectif dédié, son zoom 2x reposant sur un recadrage, ni l'autonomie confortable que l'on attend généralement d'un smartphone de cette taille.
✅ Les points forts
- Un écran Dynamic AMOLED 2X de 6,7 pouces noté 9 sur 10 par la rédaction Clubic
- Une finesse de 5,8 mm et un poids de 163 g rares sur cette diagonale
- Un capteur principal de 200 Mpx convaincant en photo comme en vidéo
- Un châssis en titane certifié IP68, protégé par du Gorilla Glass Ceramic 2
- Sept ans de mises à jour logicielles annoncées par Samsung
❌ Les limites
- Une autonomie en retrait, avec une batterie de 3 900 mAh seulement
- Une charge filaire plafonnée à 25 W, sans chargeur fourni dans la boîte
- Pas de téléobjectif dédié, le zoom 2x reposant sur un recadrage numérique
- Une prise en main jugée trop fine pour être confortable dans notre test
Les stocks bougent vite pendant les French Days : vérifiez la disponibilité du Galaxy S25 Edge à 599 € chez Darty !
À 599 €, le Galaxy S25 Edge devient une proposition nettement plus défendable qu'à son lancement. Le principal grief formulé dans notre test Clubic, celui du prix, disparaît, alors que ses qualités restent intactes : un écran remarquable, une partie photo solide et une construction irréprochable. Si vous appréciez les smartphones fins et légers, et que vous n'avez pas envie de vous encombrer d'un appareil massif, l'offre a du sens.
Si votre priorité est de tenir deux jours loin d'une prise, ou de disposer d'un vrai zoom optique, mieux vaut orienter votre budget vers un modèle plus classique et mieux doté en batterie. Pour tous les autres, ces French Days offrent une fenêtre intéressante pour s'offrir un haut de gamme Samsung au prix d'un très bon milieu de gamme.
