articles.title: Stockholm-based Fluencify raises €3.7 million to scale its end-to-end creator marketing platform | EU-Startups
articles.text:
Fluencify, a Stockholm-based end-to-end creator marketing platform, has raised an oversubscribed €3.7 million ($4.3 million) pre-Seed funding round.
The oversubscribed round was led by byFounders, with participation from Wave Ventures. The fundraising comes as the company surpasses €1.7 million ($2 million) ARR in just six months after launching the platform. Magnus Hambleton of byFounders will join Fluencify’s board.
Hambleton, Partner at byFounders, commented, “As building products becomes easy, getting the word out about them has only gotten more important. User-generated content is the purest way to do so: users recruit new users. Erik, Sam and Isaac have a deep understanding of how social media works and have combined that with outlier levels of hustle to create a solution that actually works. The biggest brands in the world need to use Fluencify to keep up their extraordinary speeds of growth.”
Founded in 2025 by Erik Romdhane, Isaac Norin, and Sam Stones Hälleberg, Fluencify is an AI-run service that helps brands create and distribute authentic short-form content at scale through a global network of vetted creators.
Romdhane has worked in creator marketing since his mid-teens and co-founded and sold an influencer agency at 17. Norin and Hälleberg founded an AI voice note app as teenagers, with the latter amassing over 1 million followers and 500 million views worldwide as an Instagram creator.
The company runs creator marketing campaigns end-to-end. According to the company, a brand defines the desired outcome for a campaign, and AI agents handle creator discovery and matching, enabling automated outreach and reply handling.
Fluencify’s agents brief creators on the content brands are seeking and field any questions early in the process. Once confirmed, Fluencify automatically schedules posts and paid boosting, as well as cross-border creator payouts across 85+ countries.
According to the company, creator marketing is run through traditional influencer and UGC agencies, creator marketplaces and campaign software, or in-house creator teams at larger brands. Fluencify states that it differs from existing software tools by running the campaign rather than selling a tool, and from the agencies by doing it with automated agents.
The company works on an ambassador model, where creators work with a brand on a recurring basis rather than one-off paid posts. The company has more than 13,000 active creators on the platform, working with brands with a combined market capitalisation of €25.8 billion ($30 billion).
With Fluencify’s coordinating agents, creator marketing can be run continuously by a brand rather than on a campaign-by-campaign basis. This also means that creators earn more predictably from their work wherever they live.
Romdhane, CEO and co-founder of Fluencify, commented, “From my experience on both sides of the table, as an influencer and running an agency, I found the creative elements of the work were the smallest part. Most of the hours went to finding the right creators, chasing replies, writing briefs, developing content, and paying people across borders. This is work that only scales by hiring. We wanted to build a system so a brand can describe the outcome it wants and get the campaign run end to end, without all the legwork. We’re looking forward to scaling into the US with this backing from byFounders.”
The company plans to use this capital to hire engineers in Stockholm, open a New York office, build out US sales, expand its creator network, and strengthen its product offering to current clients.
Fluencify works with a range of consumer and prosumer software companies, specialising in products that demo well on camera, from AI and productivity tools to education apps and consumer apps.

articles.title: Mathspace discloses data breach affecting over 1 million people
articles.text:
Online maths learning platform Mathspace disclosed over the weekend that attackers stole data from more than 1 million students, staff, and parents after breaching its Metabase internal reporting system.
Founded in Sydney in 2010, Mathspace is now used by thousands of schools across Australia, New Zealand, the United States, and the United Kingdom (3,432 in Australia and 3,557 abroad according to statistics reported by the company in 2023).
In a Saturday blog post, Mathspace CTO Alvin Savoy said that unknown attackers gained access to the company's systems and stole personal information belonging to school staff and students, as well as their parents and guardians.
"On 3 September 2026, we confirmed that unauthorised parties had accessed an internal reporting system used by Mathspace and downloaded information on students, their parents or guardians, and school staff. Mathspace staff records were also affected," Savoy said.
"Attackers exploited a security vulnerability in our self-hosted installation of Metabase, software we use for internal reporting. The vulnerability allowed attackers to obtain administrator access to that system without a legitimate login."
While the data theft was confirmed on September 3, the threat actors gained access to the compromised systems on August 10 and downloaded the data from Mathspace's Australian reporting database on August 27.
Savoy noted that only students and school staff from Australia and New Zealand had their data stolen in the incident. Although the attackers didn't steal credentials, academic records and information, in some cases they may have been able to link some impacted accounts to their schools.
"A total of 1,079,819 people were affected, comprising students, staff, and parents or guardians combined. Only people in Australia and New Zealand were affected," he added.
"No academic records, learning activities, results, assessment records, passwords (hashes), authentication tokens, SSO credentials, or API credentials were exposed. The exposed data did not include records linking user accounts to their schools. However, for schools with identifiable email domains, we understand this may be possible."
Savoy also warned affected students and school staff that attackers may target them using the stolen data, and advised them to watch for suspicious account-related activity, such as changes to account details and password-reset messages.
Metabase breaches claimed by ShinyHunters
This breach adds to a string of other incidents impacting the Metabase instances of multiple other companies worldwide over the last month,
As BleepingComputer previously reported, threat actors exploited a critical Metabase SQL injection zero-day vulnerability to breach customer instances and steal data after gaining administrator access.
Trezor revealed on August 13 that attackers stole the data of nearly 14,000 customers after hacking its shipping and logistics provider, ShipMonk. On Friday, it warned that the number of affected individuals has risen to 81,000.
Although Trezor has yet to attribute the attack to a specific threat actor or hacking group, BleepingComputer has learned that ShipMonk has received extortion emails from the ShinyHunters extortion gang. ShinyHunters also added Metabase to its dark web leak site on August 11.
The list of affected companies in this campaign also includes laptop maker Framework and online form-building platform Tally, which have also disclosed data breaches after their Metabase instances were hijacked.
Previously, ShinyHunters has been linked to breaches at more than a dozen Snowflake customers, Salesloft Drift and Salesforce Aura campaigns targeting hundreds of Salesforce customers, and over 100 enterprise victims following data-theft attacks that exploited an Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day flaw.
Once attackers have valid credentials, only 37% of their actions are blocked
Overall prevention scores can hide what happens after initial access. Once attackers are using valid credentials, prevention drops sharply.

Ugreen FineTrack Slim Duo 2

articles.title: Plaud One : on a vu les écouteurs IA qui veulent changer votre façon de travailler
articles.text:
À l’occasion de l’IFA, Plaud présente son dernier produit, le Plaud One. Une nouvelle IA qui prend cette fois-ci la forme d’écouteurs. Pensée pour les professionnels, elle permet d’enregistrer des conversations en direct, des appels passés via les écouteurs ou encore des réunions en ligne. Le produit est d’ores et déjà disponible en précommande au prix de 249,90 euros.
Une IA pour les pro ?
Le principe reste proche de celui du Plaud Note, mais Plaud change ici complètement de format. Fini le boîtier au format carte de crédit Plaud mise désormais sur des écouteurs. La véritable différence avec les autres produits Plaud réside dans la connectivité du produit. Plaud One intègre une eSIM.
Le principe reste néanmoins le même, Plaud One permet d’enregistrer les conversations en personne, avec les écouteurs, mais aussi les appels et les réunions en ligne. L’utilisation se veut simple il suffit de maintenir le bouton présent sur le boîtier des écouteurs ou de dire simplement « Hey Plaud » pour commencer l’enregistrement. L’IA analyse ensuite ce qui vient d’être dit et peut répondre par le haut-parleur du boîtier ou directement dans l’oreille. L’appareil peut enregistrer l’ensemble d’une pièce jusqu’à une distance maximale de 5 mètres. Chaque conversation est automatiquement retranscrite, résumée et ajoutée au contexte de l’agent.
Côté audio, les écouteurs disposent d’une réduction de bruit active ANC adaptative pouvant atteindre 40 dB en hybride. Côté autonomie, Plaud annonce jusqu’à 4,5 heures avec l’ANC activé et jusqu’à 6 heures avec l’ANC désactivée. Le boîtier peut, lui, assurer jusqu’à 25 heures d’enregistrement en continu, et jusqu’à 6 heures pour les écouteurs.
Prix et disponibilité
Plaud One est disponible en précommande sur le site officiel de Plaud au prix de 249,90 euros. Le produit est proposé dans un seul coloris : blanc. En renouvellant le format de l’assistant IA Plaud espère créer une nouvelle façon d’interragir avec son gadget. Pour notre part, après avoir vu de près le produit sur le salon, on a évidemment hâte de le tester en conditions réelles. Car si format carte fait l’affaire et qu’il bénéficie d’une relative discretion, c’est évidemment moins évident pour des écouteurs.

articles.title: Les hybrides rechargeables polluent de plus en plus, et vous en êtes probablement la cause
articles.text:
Les hybrides rechargeables polluent de plus en plus, et vous en êtes probablement la cause
Les voitures hybrides rechargeables sont un échec côté pollution avec des émissions de CO2 jusqu’à cibq fois plus élevées que les chiffres des constructeurs. La faute à la recharge délaissée par les conducteurs.
Souvent présentées comme la solution idéale pour ceux qui trouvent la voiture électrique limitante en matière d’autonomie, les voitures hybrides rechargeables ne sont pas plus écologiques. Bien que cela soit le cas sur le papier, les mauvaises habitudes des conducteurs rendent en effet ces véhicules particulièrement polluants dans la réalité. Une information confirmée par une vaste étude européenne, qui constate d’ailleurs que la pollution de ces modèles augmente année après année.
Un gouffre entre les tests officiels et la réalité pour les hybrides rechargeables
L’International Council on Clean Transportation (ICCT), ONG déjà à l’origine du fameux Dieselgate, vient d’analyser les données de plus de 900 000 véhicules hybrides rechargeables immatriculés en Europe entre 2021 et 2023. Les résultats montrent que ces modèles ont émis en moyenne 4,6 fois plus de CO2 que les valeurs officielles d’homologation, contre 3,5 fois plus en 2021. Un décalage qui s’aggrave étonnamment au fil du temps, malgré des progrès techniques notables.
Des batteries plus grosses, mais moins branchées
Paradoxalement, l’autonomie électrique théorique de ces voitures a augmenté, passant de 58 à 68 km en moyenne. Un gain important qui ne s’est toutefois pas traduit par un changement des habitudes des conducteurs. L’étude démontre notamment que la part des trajets effectués en mode “zéro émission” a reculé, chutant de 26 % pour les modèles de 2021 à seulement 17 % pour ceux de 2023.
Les automobilistes profitent donc de batteries plus imposantes, mais s’abstiennent de les brancher régulièrement pour rouler à l’électrique. Les hybrides rechargeables se transforment dès lors en de lourdes voitures thermiques qui surconsomment du carburant et, de facto, polluent plus que prévu.
La norme de calcul européenne revue pour 2027
C’est pourquoi la Commission européenne a annoncé revoir sa copie en 2027 avec un mode de calcul officiel réajusté pour mieux refléter les conditions réelles d’utilisation. Une révision réglementaire qui devrait logiquement réduire l’attrait de cette motorisation de transition (entre le thermique et le 100 % électrique) pour les constructeurs, qui s’en servaient pour abaisser artificiellement la moyenne des émissions de leur flotte.
Reste maintenant à savoir comment évolueront les consommateurs. Ces derniers se rabattront-ils sur le thermique ou l’hybride classique ? Tenteront-ils quand même l’expérience de l’hybride rechargeable, quitte à trop polluer, ou à enfin adopter les bonnes pratiques ? Feront-ils le grand saut vers les modèles entièrement électriques ?

articles.title: RPCS3 Emulator Now Lets You Play PS3 Games Directly From the Disc
articles.text:
Monday, September 7th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
RPCS3 Emulator Now Lets You Play PS3 Games Directly From the Disc
RPCS3, the popular open-source PlayStation 3 emulator, now lets you play games straight off a physical Blu-ray disc, without dumping to a hard drive or SSD. The team announced the change on X, calling it "plug and play," and noted it works with games released as far back as 20 years ago without needing to reach out to any servers. A compatible Blu-ray drive is still required, and RPCS3 keeps a running list of supported models from LG, ASUS, Samsung, Lite-On, Sony, HP, Plextor, and BenQ on its site. The feature started out Windows-only but has since been extended to Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD as well, and package installations run from the disc drive are apparently faster now. 
PS4 and PS5 owners running Linux can reportedly even launch PS3 games directly from a disc through RPCS3. Credit for the work goes to contributors digant73 and Megamouse, according to the RPCS3 team. Sony is ending physical disc production for new PlayStation games starting January 2028, so RPCS3 pulling in the opposite direction seems rather intentional. The project also added Steam library integration a while back, letting emulated games launch like any other title in your library to further reduce friction. This new update is another step towards increasing convenience, and it's definitely a nice little boost for owners of PS3 physical media.

articles.title: One UI 9 es aún mejor: esta opción le da más vida a la batería de tu Samsung
articles.text:
Que One UI 9 es una de las mejores actualizaciones que ha hecho Samsung es una realidad. Ahora bien, este nuevo software está incluyendo cosas que no se esperaban y que lo hacen todavía más atractivo. De hecho, si tienes un Samsung, es probable que recibas tres nuevas configuraciones para alargar la autonomía y que la batería te dure aún más todos los días. Son detalles que ya estaban en los Galaxy S26 desde hace meses, pero ahora llegan por sorpresa a más modelos como los Galaxy S24, Galaxy S25 y más.
¿Cuál es el requisito para recibir las novedades? Que tu móvil Samsung tenga una pantalla LTPO. En otras palabras, un panel que puede actualizar su tasa de refresco a placer para que todo se vea más fluido solo cuando hace realmente falta. Esta tecnología permite llevar esta frecuencia hasta números muy bajos para ahorrar batería, lo que hace que los dispositivos de la compañía sean sumamente eficientes.
¿Qué ha incluido One UI 9 para poder aprovechar aún mejor este tipo de paneles LTPO? Incluir más intervalos de frecuencia para que la interfaz pueda adaptarse mejor y gastar menos batería cuando estás visualizando contenido que no necesita 120, 60 o 90 Hz. Estas pantallas pueden bajar hasta 1 Hz, pero en algunas situaciones los móviles Samsung daban el salto a los 60 Hz para no empeorar la experiencia.
Ahora no será necesario. One UI 9 ha incluido tres nuevas cifras: 20, 26,67 y 40 Hz. El resultado, más allá de lo técnico, es que tu móvil será capaz de bajar esta frecuencia aún más sin condicionar la experiencia, haciendo que los 60 Hz ya no sean un estándar cuando ves cierto tipo de contenido.
¿El resultado? Un menor gasto energético para los modelos que actualicen a One UI 9 y tengan una de estas pantallas LPTO. En otras palabras, una mejor autonomía diaria sin tener que hacer nada. Estas nuevas tasas de refresco se implementan solas cuando el sistema detecte que son compatibles con el contenido y no empeoran la experiencia.
¿Qué móviles Samsung reciben esta novedad de One UI 9?
La novedad ya se ha dejado ver en varios dispositivos de la marca que han conseguido actualizar a One UI 9, pero, dado que es una función compatible con pantallas LTPO, es probable que todos los modelos que tienen esta tecnología puedan aprovecharla. Aquí tienes la lista completa.
- Toda la serie Galaxy S24
- Toda la serie Galaxy S25
Por ahora, los dispositivos de gama media de Samsung no incluyen este tipo de paneles LTPO, por lo que, aunque actualicen a One UI 9, no podrán tener esta novedad.

articles.title: Sony brings back its fan-favorite headphones, the XM4
articles.text:
Six years ago Sony and Bose were in the middle of a noise-canceling battle, with each new model of headphones better than the last. In the fall of 2020, Sony released the WH-1000XM4 headphones to wide acclaim. They sat atop best headphones lists for years, thanks to their great sound, competitive ANC, and compact size, until they went out of stock. Now Sony has brought them back, with minor improvements, as the WH-1000XM4C.
Six years later, Sony revisits its legendary XM4 headphones
After the WH-1000XM4 were discontinued in 2025, Sony is bringing them back as the WH-1000XM4C.
The XM4C look identical to the original XM4 (although they now have a lavender option), with the same hinge design and ability to fold up. It’s a compact design that Sony moved away from when it released the XM5 in 2022, and then returned to (although not quite as compact) with the XM6. But it’s not just the look that’s returned. The XM4C still use the same QN1 processing chip and four microphones for ANC. That design is showing its age: The XM5 still used the QN1, but had eight mics. Last year’s XM6 have 12, plus the new QN3 chip.
Sony did update the XM4C’s sound profile to bring it in line with current models, and the headphones have a 10-band EQ in the Headphones app, instead of the 5-band on the XM4, plus a gaming preset. The XM4C also support Bluetooth 6 instead of 5. Surprisingly, the battery performance on the new headphones is slightly worse. Sony claims the XM4C get up to 27 hours of use with ANC on as opposed to 30 hours previously. Not a huge difference, and still more than enough for a cross-country trip.
The XM4C will be available later this fall for $300, which is $50 cheaper than the XM4 when they first came out (and $100 cheaper than the XM6 are now), but more than they could be found for before being discontinued.
I have loved the Sony XM4 since they came out, and still have my pair hanging on the side of my desk. Beyond nostalgia, though, I’m confused why they’re coming back. A review sample of the XM4C arrived at my door while I was writing this, so some deeper investigation will be coming soon. But the headphones industry has moved forward in the past six years, and I’m not sure there’s a need to go back. And the XM5, while they don’t fold up as nicely as the XM4C, are excellent headphones and currently available for $200 (though that price may be an effort to clear out inventory ahead of the XM4C).
Alongside the XM4C, Sony released the next generation of two of its less-expensive midrange and entry-level headphone lines: the WH-CH730N and WH-CH530. They both get the same 10-band EQ upgrade and gaming EQ preset as the XM4C, and the CH730N will now fold up into a more compact form.
The two headphones also get a boost to battery life according to Sony: The CH730N get up to 50 hours with ANC, and the CH530 get up to 55 hours (there’s no ANC on the CH530). A new safe mode in the app allows a user to limit the max volume output of the headphones. It’s a nice addition for parents looking to protect their kids’ hearing, although there’s no way to lock the limit once it’s been set.
The WH-CH530 come in black, cobalt, mint green, white, pink, and coral and cost $70. For $180, you can get the WH-CN730N in black, blue, oat, white, or pink. Both headphones are available now.
Sony is also doing a partnership with Hello Kitty. Bundles include headphones — the WH-1000XM6, WH-CH730N, or WH-CH530 available in black or pink — a Hello Kitty-shaped carrying pouch, and Hello Kitty-branded bag. The bundles will be available in limited supply later this year on the Sony website only.

articles.title: TÜV-geprüfte KI: Verband plant Zertifizierung für Künstliche Intelligenz
articles.text:
TÜV-geprüfte KI: Verband plant Zertifizierung für Künstliche Intelligenz
Wie vertrauenswürdig ist diese oder jene Anwendung Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI)? Das soll bald durch ein TÜV-Zertifikat erkennbar sein. Wie der TÜV-Verband in Berlin mitteilte, erproben die TÜV-Organisationen im Moment ein KI-Zertifizierungsprogramm mit Pilotpartnern. Bereits Ende des Jahres könnten diese KI-Zertifizierungen schrittweise eingeführt werden.
TÜV-Prüfung soll Vertrauen stärken
Die TÜV-Organisationen entwickeln eine dreistufige KI-Zertifizierung, wie es vom TÜV-Verband hieß. Sie sollen sich in Umfang, Methodik und Tiefe der Prüfung unterscheiden. Es richte sich nach dem jeweiligen Anwendungsfall, welche Prüfung genau dabei zum Einsatz komme. Die erste Zertifizierung richtet sich demnach an Systeme, die nicht zur Hochrisikokategorie des AI Acts fallen. Die zweite steht allen Systemen offen und umfasst eine „KI‑spezifische Risikobewertung“ sowie die Überprüfung auf Umsetzung der Anforderungen durch den Hersteller. Für die dritte Zertifizierung sollen ausgewählte Eigenschaften eines KI-System durch unabhängige Tests überprüft werden.
Besonders wichtig ist das offenbar für Endkund:innen, so habe eine Studie von TÜV-Verband ergeben, dass 79 Prozent der Deutschen „unkalkulierbare Risiken durch KI“ befürchten. Von den Nutzer:innen, die KI regelmäßig anwenden, glauben nur 53 Prozent, dass die Ergebnisse von Chatbots und Co. korrekt sind.
„Unternehmen müssen gegenüber Kunden, Geschäftspartnern und Anwendern nachweisen können, dass ihre KI-Systeme nicht nur leistungsfähig sind, sondern auch zuverlässig und sicher funktionieren“, sagte der TÜV-Digitalisierungsexperte Marc Fliehe laut Mitteilung. Mit seinen Zertifizierungen wolle der TÜV das Vertrauen der Menschen in KI-Anwendungen stärken.

articles.title: Switch 2 collector, date pour Ocarina of Time, film… : tout ce que l'on attend au Ninendo Direct centré sur Zelda
articles.text:
Cette semaine sera une fête pour les fans de Nintendo. Les concernés pourront effectivement visionner deux nouveaux Direct, les mardi 8 et mercredi 9 septembre. Le premier, d’une durée de 30 minutes et débutant à 16h, heure française, sera centré sur la saga The Legend of Zelda, à l’occasion de son 40e anniversaire.
Il ne fait aucun doute que l’essentiel de la présentation se focalisera sur le remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, attendu pour la fin d’année. Il y aura d’autres annonces, et pas uniquement liées au monde du jeu vidéo, comme l’a fait savoir Nintendo dans un message publié sur X le 7 septembre : « Nous vous présenterons des initiatives autres que les jeux liées au 40e anniversaire de The Legend of Zelda, ainsi que des détails sur le jeu Nintendo Switch 2 The Legend of Zelda : Ocarina of Time. »
Qu’attendre du Nintendo Direct sur les 40 ans de Zelda ?
Le plein de détails et la date de sortie pour The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Nintendo a officialisé il y a quelques mois un remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, à destination du catalogue de la Switch 2. Pour le moment, les détails à son sujet sont minimes et ce Direct sera l’occasion d’en apprendre plus sur ce jeu attendu pour cette fin d’année. Remake 1:1 ? Libertés par rapport au jeu d’origine ? Apports pour le gameplay ? Données techniques ? Autant de questions qui devraient trouver leur réponse, sans compter l’une des plus importantes : la date de sortie.
Une Switch 2 collector
C’est un secret de polichinelle. Le lancement de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sera l’occasion idéale pour Nintendo de commercialiser la toute première Switch 2 collector. Elle sera aux couleurs de la saga, et tout y passera : la console elle-même, les Joy-Con 2 et la manette Pro. Ces produits ont fait l’objet d’une fuite, et on sait déjà à quoi ils ressembleront.
Une bande-annonce pour le film en prises de vue réelle
Quand Nintendo évoque « des initiatives autres que les jeux », il est difficile de ne pas penser au film actuellement en préparation, fruit d’une collaboration entre Nintendo et Sony Pictures. Pour le moment, les deux entreprises n’ont partagé que des images officielles montrant Link et Zelda, respectivement incarnés par Benjamin Evan Ainsworth et Bo Bragason. Le film est attendu pour le 28 avril 2027 dans les salles françaises, le timing pour une première bande-annonce est donc idéal.
D’autres jeux vidéo ?
Pour patienter jusqu’à la sortie du remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Nintendo pourrait recycler d’autres épisodes, via des remasterisations à paraître sur Switch et Switch 2. De The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker à The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, il y a l’embarras du choix. Une compilation façon Mario est même envisageable. Sans oublier la possibilité de garnir l’abonnement Nintendo Switch Online.
Lego et merchandising ?
40 ans représentent tout de même un sacré anniversaire. Nintendo a même créé un logo spécial pour l’occasion. Connaissant les habitudes de la multinationale, il y aura toute une batterie de produits portant le logo en question, avec pour objectif de vendre un maximum de merchandising aux fans. On pense à une troisième collaboration avec Lego, après l’arbre Mojo et le set inspiré de… The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

articles.title: Une caméra Apple dans votre salon d'ici 2027, et elle fonctionnerait sans stocker vos vidéos
articles.text:
Apple préparerait une caméra de sécurité domestique pilotée par l’IA pour 2027, accompagnée d’un service de surveillance inédit. Particularité annoncée : l’appareil analyserait son environnement sans stocker de séquences vidéo.
Apple avance ses pions dans la maison connectée, et la prochaine étape va bien au-delà du hardware. Selon Mark Gurman, relayé par 9to5Mac, Cupertino travaillerait sur un service de sécurité et de surveillance à domicile, prévu pour 2027. Au cœur du dispositif : une caméra de sécurité IA qui se distinguerait d’emblée de la concurrence par son approche de la confidentialité. L’appareil analyserait l’environnement du domicile sans s’appuyer sur l’enregistrement d’images vidéo traditionnelles, une proposition qui tranche net avec ce que proposent aujourd’hui Google Nest ou Ring.
Une caméra qui surveille sans enregistrer, ou presque
Cette possible caméra Apple reposerait bien évidemment sur l’intelligence artificielle embarquée : l’appareil détecterait une présence, une activité inhabituelle ou certains événements sans enregistrer continuellement ce qui se passe à l’intérieur du domicile. L’IA servirait à comprendre l’environnement plutôt qu’à capturer des images brutes, ce qui permettrait à Apple de mettre en avant la confidentialité comme argument commercial central.
Ce positionnement n’est pas anodin dans un marché où les caméras connectées de la concurrence ont régulièrement essuyé des critiques pour leurs pratiques de stockage et de partage de données. Apple, qui a bâti une partie de son image sur la protection des données personnelles, pousse la logique encore plus loin avec ce projet : pas d’image, pas de fuite possible. Apple Intelligence s’invite déjà dans l’app Maison, et la caméra de 2027 s’inscrirait dans cette même direction.
Un écosystème qui prend forme, avec un service en plus du matériel
La caméra ne serait qu’une pièce d’un ensemble plus ambitieux. Apple s’apprêterait aussi à lancer un hub domotique équipé d'un écran, un HomePod mini renouvelé et une nouvelle Apple TV 4K. Ces trois appareils Home seraient attendus prochainement, possiblement dès le mois de septembre 2026 pour les deux derniers, avant que la caméra de sécurité ne rejoigne la gamme en 2027.
Ce qui distingue cette annonce des précédentes, c’est la dimension service. Le futur capteur fonctionnerait avec un nouveau service de surveillance domestique sous la forme d'un abonnement indépendant ou d’une intégration à Apple One (les deux pistes circuleraient selon Gurman). Ni le tarif, ni le fonctionnement précis du service, ni les données exactes qu’il traiterait ne sont encore connus. Pour le moment, aucune fourchette de prix n’est évoquée, même si Gurman avait déjà laissé entendre qu’Apple nourrissait des ambitions dans ce domaine depuis un moment.
Apple jouerait ici une carte qu’elle maîtrise mieux que quiconque : vendre la confidentialité comme une fonctionnalité premium. Une caméra qui surveille sans vraiment enregistrer, c’est séduisant sur le papier, mais cela soulève aussi des questions concrètes : à quel point l’IA peut-elle remplacer la vidéo pour détecter une intrusion ? Et surtout, les utilisateurs seront-ils prêts à payer un énième abonnement supplémentaire, même si celui-ci servira à protéger leur domicile ?

articles.title: Trezor data breach impact now reaches 81,000 customers
articles.text:
Cryptocurrency hardware wallet maker Trezor says an August data breach at its shipping and logistics provider, ShipMonk, affects an additional 67,000 U.S. customers.
In total, the breach has affected 81,000 customers after Trezor initially disclosed on August 13 that attackers accessed the data of nearly 14,000 customers, including their full names, shipping addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers.
As the company explained at the time, the incident also affected customers in Brazil, Colombia, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, and the United Kingdom who received orders between May 10 and August 8, 2026.
On Friday, it published an update to confirm that the breach impact has expanded after ShipMonk failed to delete the exposed data from its systems as required by Trezor's contract and data policy.
"Another 67,000 customers from the US who ordered between November 2019 and August 2021 were affected, with their full details (name, email, phone number, shipping address, order number) exposed," Trezor said.
"Throughout our entire relationship with ShipMonk, we repeatedly requested and received written assurance confirming the deletion of the data, in line with our contract, data policy, and past communications. We are very disappointed that, despite receiving this confirmation, the data was not deleted in their systems."
The company added that the breach did not affect its operations or services, that its systems were not compromised, and that all Trezor devices are secure.
It also warned affected customers to be wary of any messages requesting personal information, as they may be targeted in phishing attacks.
"Be aware of the increased risk of phishing. The leaked information could be used for scam emails, fraudulent calls or letters, and could potentially expose affected individuals to physical security risks," Trezor said.
Metabase campaign linked to ShinyHunters extortion gang
While the company has yet to share how ShipMonk's systems were breached, breach notification emails sent to affected customers and seen by BleepingComputer said the attackers exploited a vulnerability in the third-party analytics platform Metabase.
As BleepingComputer previously reported, Metabase revealed that the threat actors exploited a critical SQL injection zero-day vulnerability to breach customer instances and carry out data theft attacks after gaining administrator access to the compromised instance.
BleepingComputer has also learned that ShipMonk has received extortion emails from the ShinyHunters extortion gang.
The list of affected companies in the Metabase campaign includes online form-building platform Tally and laptop maker Framework, which have also notified customers of data breaches after their instances were hijacked.
In January 2024, Trezor disclosed another data breach after threat actors compromised its third-party support ticketing portal and accessed data (e.g., names, usernames, and email addresses) from roughly 66,000 users.
This stolen data was later used in phishing attacks attempting to steal recipients' 24-word wallet recovery seeds.
Once attackers have valid credentials, only 37% of their actions are blocked
Overall prevention scores can hide what happens after initial access. Once attackers are using valid credentials, prevention drops sharply.

articles.title: ISRO says it is not being privatised as space reforms reshape its role
articles.text:
ISRO says it is not being privatised as space reforms reshape its role
ISRO rejects claims of privatisation, while acknowledging a wider reform programme that moves mature rocket and satellite production towards industry.
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has firmly rejected reports that it is being privatised or that its role in India’s space programme is being reduced. The clarification came after a series of reports about plans to move more rocket and satellite manufacturing, and potentially parts of launch operations, from ISRO to private industry.
Nine ISRO employee associations had also sought formal answers from Chairman V Narayanan on where the transition was heading.
In its September 6 statement, ISRO said the reports had led to “speculations and misinformation” and described claims of an attempt to privatise the organisation or reduce its importance as baseless. It added that ISRO would remain the country’s principal institution for advanced space research, technology development, strategic and national missions, space science and exploration, and critical technologies.
The clarification is significant because the underlying change is real, even if calling it the privatisation of ISRO is misleading. ISRO acknowledges that mature technologies and routine production can increasingly be handled by industry, allowing its scientists and engineers to concentrate on more advanced work.
“Participation of private sector in space is not about reducing ISRO’s role. It is about enabling ISRO to focus even more strongly on the next generation of India’s space programme, while industry scales mature technologies and capabilities,” the statement said.
The immediate concerns arose after remarks by Pawan Goenka, chairman of the Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe). Goenka envisaged ISRO eventually moving away from routine launch-vehicle manufacturing and focusing more heavily on research, strategic missions and new technologies. He also noted that India needs to expand its launch cadence dramatically.
“We have set ourselves an ambitious target of 50 launches a year by 2030. A goal of this scale cannot be achieved by one organisation alone,” Goenka said in a September 6 post.
Last September, ISRO, NSIL and IN-SPACe signed an agreement with Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd for transfer of Small Satellite Launch Vehicle technology. SSLV is designed for relatively small satellites and was developed specifically as a production-friendly, quick-turnaround launcher. ISRO said the vehicle was intended to be manufactured in large numbers by industry.
This August, however, ISRO was still testing an improved SSLV first stage, illustrating that technology development has not simply stopped with the transfer of production.
PSLV production is also moving towards industry. ISRO’s 2025-26 annual report says NSIL has contracted HAL-led industry for end-to-end production of five PSLV-XL vehicles, with the first industry-produced PSLV scheduled for 2026. NSIL, notably, remains a wholly government-owned company and is the commercial arm of ISRO.
The broader policy shift dates to 2020, when India opened the space sector to private participation across the value chain, followed by the Indian Space Policy 2023 and a liberalised foreign direct investment framework. IN-SPACe was created to promote, authorise and supervise non-government space activities, while NSIL was tasked with commercialisation and enabling industry-led production.
All these developments have produced a substantially larger private ecosystem. Government figures put the number of space startups at around 440 by August 2026, with private companies active in launch vehicles, satellites, propulsion, ground systems and applications. Private investment has also crossed $600 million over five years, while a Rs 1,000 crore venture capital fund and a Rs 500 crore Technology Adoption Fund have been introduced to support the sector.
The real issue, therefore, is less whether ISRO is being privatised and more how far the division of labour will go. ISRO said strategic capabilities, frontier research, human spaceflight and major national missions will remain central to its work. Its employee associations, meanwhile, are asking for clarity on whether transferring manufacturing and operations could eventually leave the organisation primarily as an R&D body.
India’s latest GSLV mission, which successfully placed EOS-05 into orbit on September 4, highlights that ISRO remains fully operational at the centre of the national programme.
The more consequential transition is taking place around it, as India attempts to build a much larger commercial space industry without weakening the public institution that developed the country’s capabilities in the first place.

articles.title: Bosch renueva su catálogo: nueva lavadora-secadora Serie 8 con bomba de calor, campanas silenciosas y frigoríficos de gran capacidad
articles.text:
En la feria IFA 2026 de Berlín, Bosch ha mostrado su nueva generación de electrodomésticos pensados para maximizar la eficiencia energética y simplificar las tareas cotidianas en casa. La marca alemana centra sus novedades en una revolucionaria lavadora-secadora 2 en 1 fabricada en España, soluciones de refrigeración Side by Side y campanas con diseño inclinado.
Lava-secadora Serie 8 con bomba de calor
Es la gran protagonista en la categoría de cuidado de la ropa. Combina el lavado y secado en un único electrodoméstico de dimensiones estándar con clasificación energética A en el ciclo combinado (y un 20% menos de consumo en lavado).
Está fabricada en España e incorpora autodosificación i-DOS, eliminación automática de pelusas Self Clean System y arrugado con vapor Iron Assist. Se espera que salga a la venta en primavera de 2027.
Frigoríficos y congeladores de una puerta (Side by Side)
Estos elementos incrementan la capacidad útil hasta los 736 litros al combinar ambos módulos (un 15% más en frigorífico y hasta un 35% más en congelador). Incorporan el cajón VitaFresh XXL 0 °C, tecnología Total No Frost y el sistema modular de balcones de puerta Flex Door.
Campanas inclinadas Series 4, 6 y 8
Diseñadas para ofrecer mayor ergonomía y espacio sobre la zona de cocción. Las series 6 y 8 añaden motor SilentPowerDrive, extracción automática adaptativa y sincronización inalámbrica con la placa a través de la app Home Connect, además de ser compatibles con los nuevos filtros regenerables antipolen.

articles.title: EZVIZ's new camera on wheels can roam your house to find your kids and pets - Tech Guide
articles.text:
When connecting a security camera the usual practise is to find a spot to position it inside or outside of your home but EZVIZ has released a camera that can roam around your house because it’s on wheels.
EZVIZ TAMO AIR
Tech Guide took a look at the EZVIZ Tamo Air at the IFA show in Berlin.
It has a large wheel on either side of the camera and is built with a self-righting design so it can never tip over.
This is the sort of camera people would buy to check up on their pets.
Users can log in to the camera and steer it around their home until they find their pets.
It comes with its own little charging stand so it’ll always be powered up and ready to patrol your home.
EZVIZ WEARABLE VLOGGING CAMERA
We also saw on the EZVIZ stand at IFA a wearable first-person vlogging camera.
The idea is you’d be able to wear the camera to capture your experience while being able to enjoy the live view on the charging case.
This will give users the ability to create content and capture moments without the need to pull out their smartphone or use a larger dedicated digital camera.
Despite its small design and 39g weight – it can still capture 4K wide-angle video.
Is also waterproof to a depth of 10m
EZVIZ EP4 WIRE-FREE DIGITAL PEEPHOLE
Another product customers can look forward to is the EZVIZ EP4 wire-free peephole door viewer.
The EP4 has two parts: a front outward-facing camera on the door that links to a 5.5-inch digital display on the inside of the door.
When installed customers can see what’s happening and it can also be used as a doorbell.
This is ideal for renters who want to improve their security without the need to drill holes in any walls or mount anything permanently.
All these EZVIZ products will arrive in Australia in late 2026 or early 2027.
* Stephen Fenech travelled to Berlin with support from Anker, Roborock, Dreame, Ecovacs, MOVA and EZLINK

articles.title: Suspensions qui lâchent en pleine route : Tesla contraint de rappeler des Model Y tout juste sortis d’usine
articles.text:
Les histoires de suspensions défectueuses, c’est un peu un running gag chez Tesla. Pour votre plus grand plaisir, le feuilleton continue donc de plus belle, avec un nouveau rappel opéré par la NHTSA, l’agence de sécurité routière américaine. Celle-ci met en cause une poignée de Model Y dont les fixations des suspensions avant auraient été mal serrées en usine. Une défaillance suffisante pour entraîner un accident.
Ce rappel concerne très exactement les Model Y produits entre le 26 juillet et le 4 août 2026, ce qui correspond à des modèles neufs venant tout juste d’être mis en circulation. Comment un tel défaut a-t-il pu survenir ? Le problème principal remonte à la source, où un robot d’assemblage en usine aurait été temporairement désactivé pendant la production pour des raisons encore inconnues. Peut-être par commodité ? Peut-être par économie ?
De mauvaises vérifications qui pourraient provoquer une perte de contrôle
En tout cas, les fixations des biellettes latérales de suspensions avant auraient alors été toutes considérées comme valides. Bien sûr, ce n’était pas toujours le cas, car ce même robot était chargé de contrôler leur bon serrage. Certaines d’entre elles sont donc passées entre les mailles du filet sans atteindre une résistance suffisante aux contraintes préconisées par le cahier des charges.
Un desserrage des fixations précitées pourrait s’avérer dramatique à pleine vitesse. La géométrie des suspensions avant du véhicule pourrait se modifier soudainement, ce qui briserait la stabilité du véhicule, entraînant inévitablement une perte de contrôle. Les centres Tesla vérifieront les éléments incriminés et pourront soit les resserrer, soit les remplacer entièrement à leur charge.
D’autres soucis de suspensions signalés à l’international
Le défaut ne représentant pas un danger imminent, les propriétaires recevront leurs lettres de rappel d’ici fin octobre. Il faut dire que ce problème ne concerne pas uniquement le marché américain. Plusieurs propriétaires chinois de Model Y L ont également relevé des soucis concernant ce coup-ci les suspensions arrière. Plusieurs plaintes indiquent une fatigue accélérée des suspensions conduisant à l’affaissement de la carrosserie du véhicule.
Celle-ci finit carrément par frotter les passages de roues. Certains ont alors noté une usure prématurée ou inégale de leurs pneus arrière. Le passage par l’atelier est donc incontournable pour les véhicules concernés. Tesla ne pourra pas y échapper, la marque ayant pour habitude de régler ses problèmes via des mises à jour à distance. C’était par exemple le cas sur un problème concernant le FSD touchant 3,2 millions de véhicules.
La mise à jour à distance incapable de régler ce nouveau défaut de fabrication
Les caméras du système, qui avaient du mal à détecter certaines situations dangereuses en raison de la météo, ne pouvaient signaler toute collision imminente, ce qui menait à l’accident. Tesla a choisi de résoudre le problème par une mise à jour à distance recalibrant les caméras pour leur offrir une meilleure sensibilité. Chose impossible pour les suspensions défaillantes, avec une intervention forcément physique.

articles.title: Vigilant app raises questions about cycle of duplicate platforms
articles.text:
On September 1, the Nigeria Police Force (NPF) launched the Vigilant App, a digital platform that allows Nigerians to report suspected financial fraud, upload evidence, track their cases and receive feedback.
The Force’s Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Department developed the app with stakeholders across the financial sector. The police say the platform is designed to improve how financial fraud is reported and how cases are handled with relevant institutions.
Olatunji Disu, the Inspector-General of police (IGP), described the app as part of the Force’s digital transformation. “The policing environment is changing rapidly. Crime is becoming more sophisticated, information moves faster, and citizens increasingly expect public institutions to be accessible and responsive to technology. The Nigeria police Force must, therefore, evolve with these realities.”
That sounds straightforward. But Vigilant is not entering an empty system.
We’ve been here before with the police
The police have spent years trying to use digital platforms to make it easier for Nigerians to report crimes. In 2017, the police launched Hawk Eye, an anonymous crime-reporting platform that allowed Nigerians to send information through video, voice or text. Lagos-based ICT firm Web Assets Nigeria Limited, along with other technology partners, developed the system. It was initially piloted in the Federal Capital Territory, with plans to expand to Lagos and other states.
The police said patrol vehicles equipped with mobile terminals would receive reports from a command-and-control centre for quicker responses. But by 2019, TechCabal reported that Hawk Eye had largely become defunct, raising an early example of what happens when a Police technology initiative does not survive beyond its initial rollout.
In 2021, the Force introduced Rescue Me, another platform designed to connect Nigerians to the Police Command and Control unit during emergencies and to allow them to report crimes. The app offers emergency alerts, crime reporting, reporting police officers, navigation, and ambulance requests. The Police said it was designed to facilitate rapid responses to crimes and emergencies. The app currently has more than 100,000 downloads on Google Play.
HumAngle reported in 2022 that users had already registered on the platform, although some raised concerns about how much personal information it requested. The Police defended the data collection, saying the information was needed to assist and that access to users’ photos could help identify people in danger.
The platform has also had to deal with a high volume of alerts. In March 2022, the Police said it had received more than 10,000 fake emergency alerts through Rescue Me, which created traffic on the platform and affected genuine callers.
I also downloaded the app to test the registration process. I requested an OTP three times, and as of the time of writing, I have yet to receive one.
Rescue Me, therefore, is not simply another Police app that was launched and forgotten. It has users, remains available and has been used to send emergency alerts. But its history also shows that a digital reporting channel is only one part of the response system.
The police also have a dedicated National Cybercrime Centre (NCCC) reporting system. Its current portal allows people to submit cybercrime reports, upload evidence and track cases. The NCCC describes the system as an end-to-end cybercrime investigation and victim-support platform operating 24/7 across all 36 states. It currently reports more than 146,000 reports filed and more than ₦58 billion in recovered assets.
That makes the NCCC more than just another historical police app. It is an existing system that already provides some of the functions Vigilant is introducing.
Nigerians already have places to report fraud
By a conservative count, Vigilant is at least the fourth citizen-facing reporting platform the police have introduced in under a decade.
None of this means Vigilant is destined to repeat that history. But it does mean the value of the new app has to be measured by more than whether Nigerians can submit a complaint from their phones. For financial fraud, the police are also not the only institution Nigerians can turn to.
The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), for example, has Eagle Eye, an online reporting platform designed to ease the reporting of economic and financial crimes. When it launched in July 2021, then-EFCC chairman Abdulrasheed Bawa described it as the first application of its kind by a Nigerian law-enforcement agency. The EFCC later said the platform was producing a steady stream of intelligence and had become a springboard for several investigations. The agency has continued to maintain the platform, which allows users to submit reports and upload evidence.
Banks are another part of the system. The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has required financial institutions to maintain fraud desks since 2015, giving customers a direct channel to report suspected fraud. Banks also participate in the Nigeria Electronic Fraud Forum (NeFF), which the CBN established to improve information sharing on electronic fraud across the financial industry.
NIBSS operates an Industry Fraud Reporting Portal through which financial institutions submit and share fraud information. But participation has not been universal. In 2023, NIBSS said only 60 of 163 profiled financial institutions submitted fraud data through the portal.
The CBN has also continued to tighten expectations for financial institutions. In January 2026, it said banks had agreed, through the Nigeria Electronic Fraud Forum, to reduce fraud response times to under 30 minutes as part of efforts to curb electronic fraud. The target was presented as a way to improve the chances of tracing and recovering stolen funds, although the CBN has not yet published industry-wide data showing whether banks have consistently met it.
For customers, the CBN advises those who suspect they have been victims of fraud to contact their financial institution immediately so it can freeze affected accounts and attempt to reverse unauthorised transactions.
This means Vigilant is entering a system where fraud can already be reported to banks, shared across financial institutions, and reported to law-enforcement agencies.
The more interesting question is, what happens after the report? That matters because Nigeria’s fraud problem is not simply about victims having nowhere to complain.
In 2025, digital payment fraud losses fell to ₦25.85 billion ($17.2 million) from ₦52.26 billion ($34.8 million) in 2024, according to NIBSS. But the organisation also said fraud reporting declined by 34% in the fourth quarter of 2025. NIBSS has warned that unreported fraud makes it harder to track and investigate cases.
Getting people to report fraud remains important. But once a report is made, the speed at which information moves among the victim, the financial institution, and law enforcement can determine whether money can still be traced or recovered.
The problems that follow a fraud report
In September 2025, the Police Special Fraud Unit (PSFU) held a meeting with the CBN, Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC), NIBSS, banks, and fintech companies to discuss fraud investigations. CP Rose Chollom Dung, then Commissioner of Police of the PSFU, identified several problems affecting investigations, including delays in responding to official requests, bureaucratic bottlenecks during urgent situations, inadequate real-time information sharing, and gaps in inter-agency collaboration. The Unit said these problems affected the efficiency and effectiveness of fraud investigations, pointing to a problem beyond reporting.
A victim may already have reported a fraudulent transaction to their bank. The bank may have information about where the money went. The police may need that information to investigate or trace the funds. Other financial institutions may need to act quickly.
If those institutions do not share information quickly enough, does a new platform to submit the original complaint necessarily solve the problem?
So what does Vigilant actually add?
The police’s answer appears to be coordination. The Force says it was developed with financial-sector stakeholders and is intended to support coordination with relevant institutions. But those basic functions are not entirely new within the police.
The NCCC already allows Nigerians to report cybercrime, submit evidence, and track cases. Its current platform states that investigators can handle cybercrime cases, conduct digital forensics, and support victims. So reporting, evidence submission, and case tracking do not, on their own, explain why Vigilant is needed.
The more significant difference is its stated connection to the financial sector. The app’s Google Play listing describes Vigilant as a real-time fraud intelligence, post-transaction tracing, and rapid recovery platform for banks, fintechs, telecommunications companies, insurers, and corporates.
If that integration works as intended, Vigilant could address a weakness in the existing fraud-response system.
But the public information around the launch does not yet show exactly how that coordination works in practice. It does not, for example, establish how quickly a report is routed to a bank, whether a report can trigger an immediate response from a financial institution, or how the police will measure response times through the platform.
I reached out to a source in the Police for clarification on how the platform connects with financial institutions and how reports are handled after submission, but the source declined to comment.
The ability to track a case is useful, but tracking is not the same as resolving it. The NCCC already offers case tracking. The ability to report from a phone is useful, but Nigerians already have several digital reporting channels.
Vigilant’s strongest case, therefore, is not that it gives Nigerians another place to complain. It is that it could make the handoff between the victim, banks, and law enforcement faster and more coordinated.
Another police initiative?
When it comes to police tech initiatives, a question of continuity arises. Sources within the police force who preferred to remain anonymous expressed little confidence in the Vigilant app and told TechCabal they hadn’t heard of it.
The concern is not necessarily that the police should stop building technology. It is about whether every new administration needs another platform when some existing systems already perform parts of the same job.
That concern is especially relevant because the police have already identified delays, information-sharing problems, and inter-agency bottlenecks as obstacles to fraud investigations.
A new app can make reporting easier. It cannot, by itself, make a bank respond faster, make an investigator act faster, or remove bureaucratic bottlenecks.
Vigilant does fill a possible gap, but it is not the access gap. Nigerians already have places to report fraud. Its real value will be determined by what happens after the report is submitted.
If Vigilant can connect victims, banks, and investigators quickly enough to improve tracing, response, and recovery, then the police will have added something meaningful to Nigeria’s fraud-response system. However, if the process after the report remains slow, another reporting platform will have changed the front door without changing what happens behind it.
True scale demands moving beyond surface-level integrations to robust execution. articles.title: Huion Kamvas Pad 12 Unveiled
articles.text:
Monday, September 7th 2026
	
	
	
	
Huion Kamvas Pad 12 Unveiled
Today, Huion officially announced its new Android tablet, the Kamvas Pad 12, one year following the launch of its Kamvas Slate tablet series. As an industry-leading manufacturer and innovator, Huion has expanded its product lineup to adapt to today's competitive market landscape.
Unlike Kamvas Slate series, Kamvas Pad 12 features the battery-free EMR pen PW600C, powered by the latest PenTech 4.0. The pen can magnetically attach to the tablet for superior portability and convenience. This tablet is also equipped with other eye-catching technologies and handy creative features. Let's quickly walk through its standout highlights.What Makes It Special?
With a 12.2-inch 2K (2400 x 1600) resolution and a 90 Hz refresh rate, it delivers crystal-clear details and smooth line performance. Its 3:2 aspect ratio is perfect for document reading; combined with the split-screen functionality, it boosts productivity when drawing with reference images or jotting down notes mid-read.
The tablet also features Canvas Glass 3.0 technology, the signature glass treatment featured across Huion's third-generation Kamvas creative displays. The soft-light screen reduces eye fatigue during long drawing sessions, while its textured surface delivers a realistic paper-like drawing feel. The AG+AF coating minimizes distracting reflections and prevents stubborn fingerprints and smudges from covering the screen.
Most importantly, Kamvas Pad 12 runs on the latest Android 16 OS, built to balance enhanced productivity, robust security and intuitive usability. It also comes preloaded with a full suite of creative apps, including HiPaint, Clip Studio Paint, ibisPaint X, MediBang Paint and Huion Note, enabling users to sketch and take notes anytime, anywhere.
For users focused on processing power, the tablet is driven by an 8-core MediaTek Genio 720 processor. It delivers fluid, crisp graphics with zero lag, even when running multiple apps simultaneously or creating multiple layers in the drawing application.
Is It the Perfect Tablet for You?
Kamvas Pad 12 is an all-round creative tablet built for drawing, gaming, studying and office work. It is a lightweight, portable pick for pen display and pen tablet enthusiasts who travel frequently and want to create anywhere, anytime.

articles.title: Kilian Kaminski, refurbed co-founder, joins the EU-Startups Summit 2027 | EU-Startups
articles.text:
We are excited to announce that Kilian Kaminski, co-founder of refurbed, will take the main stage at the EU-Startups Summit 2027, taking place on May 13-14 in sunny Malta! Kilian will deliver a keynote titled Fixing the future: How sustainable entrepreneurship can change the world and be profitable.
Drawing on his experience building and scaling refurbed, Kilian will explore how entrepreneurs can create businesses that combine commercial success with measurable environmental impact.
His keynote will look at the potential of circular business models, why sustainability and profitability do not have to be competing priorities, and what founders can learn from turning a mission-driven idea into a fast-growing European company.
His Story
Kilian is one of the three founders behind refurbed, the Vienna-based marketplace that is helping reshape how Europeans think about buying electronics and other consumer goods. Founded in 2017, refurbed has grown into one of Europe’s leading platforms for refurbished products, giving devices a second life while offering consumers a more affordable and sustainable alternative to buying new.
refurbed itself has raised over €160 million in total funding – the latest being a €50 million extension to Series C in 2025. As of today, the company employs almost 300 employees across 24 countries since its initial launch in Germany. With 65.000+ products available on its platform, refurbed is quickly becoming the staple source for refurbished electronics in Europe.
Before starting refurbed, Kilian worked at Amazon Germany, where he served as Head of the Amazon Certified Refurbished Program and as New Key Account Manager for some of the company’s largest electronics retail partners. He studied Communication and Business Administration in Hamburg, Shanghai, and London before turning his experience in the electronics industry towards entrepreneurship and the circular economy.
Beyond refurbed, Kilian is actively involved in shaping the future of the refurbishment industry. He is a board member of the European Refurbishment Association and regularly speaks about the regulatory foundations of the electronics industry, the opportunities presented by the circular economy, and his mission to establish refurbishment as a third major consumption category alongside “new” and “used”.
Kilian also recently joined us on the EU-Startups Podcast, where we discussed refurbed’s journey, the growing refurbishment market, building trust in second-life electronics, and the role circular economy models can play in Europe’s transition towards more sustainable consumption.
If you would like to get to know Kilian and his story before seeing him on stage in Malta, make sure to check out the episode!
The EU-Startups Summit
On May 13-14, 2027, we’ll be bringing the European startup ecosystem together once again for the EU-Startups Summit in sunny Malta. We’re expecting around 2,500 founders, investors, startup enthusiasts, and ecosystem players for two packed days of networking, inspiration, and learning.
The event will showcase many of Europe’s hottest startups and bring attendees face-to-face with some of the most successful entrepreneurs and innovators of our time. With inspiring keynotes, fireside chats, workshops, a buzzing exhibition hall, and plenty of opportunities to make valuable connections, it is set to be another unmissable edition.

articles.title: This 10-inch 4:3 television hides your retro consoles in a secret rear compartment — Unico's Traveller ULW10 trades composite video for RGB SCART and HDMI
articles.text:
This 10-inch 4:3 television hides your retro consoles in a secret rear compartment — Unico's Traveller ULW10 trades composite video for RGB SCART and HDMI
A modern take on retro TV.
Getting a retro game console to look right on a modern TV can be a challenge, as legacy video signals need to be scaled or de-interlaced, while latency and aspect-ratio issues can further make retro games look or feel different from the original experience. In an attempt to recreate the nostalgic experience, retro gaming hardware manufacturer Unico has introduced the Traveller ULW10, a CRT-inspired 10-inch TV.
According to the company, the ULW10 is a PVM (Professional Video Monitor) with a vibrant 4:3 panel that “combines the character of a classic display format with the reliability of modern technology.” In terms of connectivity, the monitor comes with RGB, VGA, and HDMI video inputs, offering support for a wide variety of consoles. There is also a USB Type-A port, while the rear compartment provides storage for compatible consoles that can be tucked behind the display. It also includes knobs and physical buttons for various settings, similar to those found on old-school televisions.
Unfortunately, the ULW10 does not include a composite video input, and Unico says the decision ultimately came down to the limited space inside its compact chassis. With room needed for the signal board and other components, the company had to choose which video inputs to include. HDMI and VGA were retained for modern devices, PCs, and video converters, while RGB SCART was selected as the analog option because it offered the best balance between compatibility and image quality. It is also worth mentioning that the ULW10 is not a CRT monitor, but it can simulate the CRT or pixel-art style of old games.
The monitor will be offered in three color options: red and white, cream white, and studio gray. The casing includes built-in carrying handles as well as speaker vents, although the monitor itself does not include any speakers. The Traveller ULW10 will be available via Kickstarter, and while pricing information has not yet been confirmed, you can reserve a ‘Founder Spot’ for $5 and receive $30 back when you back the monitor on Kickstarter.

articles.title: Governo da Suíça quer se livrar do Microsoft 365 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Governo da Suíça quer se livrar do Microsoft 365
Governo suíço iniciou um projeto piloto para substituir o Microsoft 365 pelo pacote aberto openDesk em computadores públicos.
O governo da Suíça deu início a um programa piloto que visa substituir o pacote Microsoft 365 por alternativas abertas em computadores de repartições públicas federais. Nesta fase, a medida envolve 3.000 funcionários. Eles usarão uma solução baseada no openDesk como alternativa ao Microsoft 365.
De acordo com Matthias Stürmer, professor da Universidade de Ciências Aplicadas de Berna, o governo suíço tem três objetivos principais com a medida:
As 3.000 máquinas rodarão uma implementação do openDesk, um pacote de escritório de código aberto. Além de softwares básicos, como editores de texto e de planilhas, a solução inclui ferramentas de e-mail, agenda, chat, videoconferência, entre outras.
Para a Suíça, o openDesk também é interessante porque tem origem na Alemanha — sendo presumivelmente condizente com a política de soberania digital da União Europeia — e foi desenvolvido com foco justamente na administração pública.
Porém, migrações como essa nunca são fáceis, afinal, os recursos do Microsoft 365, que incluem ferramentas como Word, Excel e PowerPoint, são populares em praticamente todo o mundo. Uma migração repentina e radical pode fazer os usuários enfrentarem problemas de compatibilidade com documentos ou terem dificuldades de adaptação, por exemplo.
É por isso que o programa piloto envolve apenas 3.000 funcionários, número que corresponde a aproximadamente 6% da força de trabalho da administração pública da Suíça.
Além disso, o openDesk está sendo testado sem que o Microsoft 365 tenha sido removido dos computadores envolvidos. Com isso, os usuários não ficarão tecnicamente desamparados se tiverem alguma dificuldade com as ferramentas do openDesk.
A expectativa do governo suíço é a de concluir a migração para os 3.000 funcionários até o fim de 2027. Se a adoção do openDesk for aprovada, é possível que a migração alcance os mais de 54.000 postos de trabalho que, atualmente, contam com o Microsoft 365, embora ainda não haja comentários sobre isso.
Antes do programa piloto, o governo suíço realizou uma “prova de conceito” com 172 funcionários. Algumas limitações foram encontradas nessa fase, mas os resultados foram suficientemente positivos para justificar a criação do programa piloto. Isso sugere que há boas chances de uma migração mais ampla ser iniciada em etapas futuras.

articles.title: Llega a España el Leapmotor B03X: un crossover 100 % eléctrico que cuesta menos de 18.000 euros y está cargado de extras
articles.text:
Por fin ha llegado a España uno de los coches eléctricos que más va a dar de que hablar en los próximos meses. Se trata del Leapmotor B03X, un crossover 100 % eléctrico del segmento B que llega por menos de 18.000 euros y con prestaciones muy avanzadas y una autonomía perfecta para desplazamientos urbanos.
El nuevo Leapmotor B03X destaca por su diseño compacto, con 4,27 metros de longitud, 1,80 de anchura y 1,64 de altura. Por otro lado, mantiene la estética tan característica de la marca, con líneas curvas y un interior muy cuidado y minimalista. El nuevo crossover compacto de Leapmotor, además, cuenta con una plataforma EV propia que permite una distancia entre ejes de 2,60 metros, lo que a su vez ofrece una buena amplitud en el interior. La compañía asegura que las partes traseras pueden disponer de hasta 94,7 centímetros de espacio para las piernas traseras y más de 1 metro de altura delantera.
Uno de los aspectos más importantes del interior del Leapmotor B03X es su maletero. Cuenta con una capacidad total de 510 litros, ampliable a 1,605 litros con los asientos traseros abatidos. Lo más interesante, es que el vehículo incluye un compartimento impermeable y lavable de 105 litros (incluido en el total de los 510 litros) que se sitúa debajo del suelo del maletero. Por si fuera poco, los asientos traseros también cuentan con cojines abatibles para aumentar el espacio vertical.
Dos versiones y dos equipamientos para el Leapmotor B03X
El Leapmotor B03X llega en diferentes configuraciones. Por un lado (y la más económica), la versión Pro, que cuenta con una batería de 39,8 kWh y un motor eléctrico de 120 kW, lo que permite una autonomía homologada de 292 Km en ciclo WLTP. Por otro, la versión ProMax, cuya batería asciende a los 53,0 kWh y cuenta con un motor de 145 kW, así como una autonomía WLTP de hasta 382 Km por hora. Ambas variantes cuentan con 200 Nm de par motor que permiten una aceleración de o a 100 Km/h en 8,6 segundos y una velocidad máxima de 160 Km /h. Además, las dos variantes cuentan con carga rápida, que permite pasar del 30 al 80 % en apenas 16 minutos.
La compañía también ha lanzado dos opciones de equipamiento. El acabado Life, disponible en dos configuraciones de batería: 39,8 kWh o 53,0 kWh, cuenta con climatización automática, faros LED, llantas de acero de 18 pulgadas, volante de cuero ecológico, pantalla de infoentretenimiento de 14,6 pulgadas y un cuadro de instrumentos digital de 8,8 pulgadas, además de un sistema de audio de seis altavoces y carga inalámbrica.
La versión Design del Leapmotor B03X, en cambio, ofrece el equipamiento de la variante Life, pero con algunos añadidos, incluyendo asientos de cuero ecológico, asiento del conductor ajustable eléctricamente, llantas de aleación de 18 pulgadas, cámara de 360 grados, retrovisores abatibles automáticamente, sensores de aparcamiento delanteros y un sistema de 12 altavoces. En este caso, esta variante solo está disponible con la opción de batería de 53,0 kWh.
Desde 17.500 euros
El nuevo Leapmotor B03X ya está disponible en España a partir de 17.500 euros (incluyendo 3,375 euros del Plan Auto+ y 900 euros de CAE) y con opciones de financiación desde 129 euros al mes.

articles.title: EcoFlow makes the miniature power station even smaller
articles.text:
If you’re in the market for a tiny power station that punches well above its size and weight then have a look at EcoFlow’s new fourth-generation River series.
EcoFlow makes the miniature power station even smaller
More energy packed into far less space makes these batteries ideal for day trips or weekend getaways.
The River 260 Gen4 features a 256Wh capacity battery while the 520 Gen4 packs in 512Wh — storing about 2.5x and 5x the energy of the largest airline-approved power banks, respectively. Better yet, the batteries are built using longer-lasting LFP chemistry that’s far less volatile. The River 260 Gen4 features four USB ports, and 300W of max continuous output delivered out its lone AC jack. The River 500 Gen4 features the same USB port selection but offers a pair of AC jacks good for 500W of continuous output.
Both of EcoFlow’s Gen4 power stations feature class-leading energy density that cuts both the weight and size, making these power stations lighter and more compact than similarly-specced competition. That makes them ideal for an overnight camping trip or photo shoot in the literal field. The EcoFlow 520 Gen4 is powerful enough to keep a standard US fridge running for about 4 hours during a blackout.
Here’s a quick comparison to show just how much energy these remarkably small power stations are packing, starting with the River 520 Gen4:
| Power Station | Capacity (Wh) | Dimensions (W × D × H) | Volume (Liters) | Weight | Volumetric Energy Density (Wh/L) | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| EcoFlow RIVER 520 Gen4 | 512 Wh | 13.9 × 17.7 × 22.9 cm | 5.63 L | 4.6 kg (10.1 lbs) | 90.9 Wh/L | 
| EcoFlow RIVER 2 Max | 512 Wh | 27.0 × 26.0 × 19.6 cm | 13.76 L | 6.1 kg (13.4 lbs) | 37.2 Wh/L | 
| Anker 535 | 512 Wh | 29.2 × 18.8 × 25.1 cm | 13.78 L | 7.6 kg (16.8 lbs) | 37.2 Wh/L | 
| Bluetti AC50B | 448 Wh | 28.0 × 20.0 × 22.0 cm | 12.32 L | 6.7 kg (14.8 lbs) | 36.4 Wh/L | 
And here’s how the River 260 Gen4 compares to some of the main competition:
| Power Station | Capacity (Wh) | Dimensions (W × D × H) | Volume (Liters) | Weight | Volumetric Energy Density (Wh/L) | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| EcoFlow RIVER 260 Gen4 | 256 Wh | 13.9 × 17.7 × 17.5 cm | 4.30 L | 3.0 kg (6.6 lbs) | 59.5 Wh/L | 
| EcoFlow RIVER 2 | 256 Wh | 24.5 × 21.4 × 14.2 cm | 7.44 L | 3.5 kg (7.7 lbs) | 34.4 Wh/L | 
| Anker Solix C300 | 288 Wh | 16.4 × 16.1 × 24.0 cm | 6.34 L | 4.1 kg (9.1 lbs) | 45.4 Wh/L | 
| Bluetti EB3A | 268.8 Wh | 25.5 × 18.0 × 18.3 cm | 8.40 L | 4.6 kg (10.1 lbs) | 32.0 Wh/L | 
Both models can serve as a UPS for your computer, with a cutover time of less than 10ms, and feature one state-of-the-art 140W USB-C PD3.1 port that’s bidirectional. That little trick lets these power stations eschew charging bricks in favor of direct DC charging from a 140W USB-C wall charger you might already own, or a portable USB-C solar panel EcoFlow will happily sell you.
EcoFlow has also addressed a common problem with all power stations that causes them to eventually die if left idling too long. By minimizing the energy spent converting stored DC to AC output, more watt-hours remain to charge your drone, bike computer, and phone, or to power your Starlink Mini and compact fridge.
The River 260 Gen4 will be available in Europe from Q4 2026, while the River 520 Gen4 will follow sometimes in Q1 2027. Pricing for both will be announced as we get closer to their global release dates.

articles.title: Windows 11 sera bientôt plus rapide, même sur les PC avec 8 Go de RAM
articles.text:
Les prochains mois seront décisifs pour Windows 11. Après avoir promis durant toute l’année 2026 qu’elle allait s’occuper de l’optimisation de son système d’exploitation, Microsoft vient de partager d’importantes nouveautés à venir pour Windows 11 à l’IFA de Berlin.
La firme de Redmond a confirmé travailler sur l’amélioration des performances globales de l’OS, avec une attention toute particulière sur l’optimisation de la mémoire.
Après un début d’année chaotique parsemé de mises à jour buguées, Microsoft avait fait amende honorable en admettant les lacunes de Windows 11. Pour corriger le tir, la firme de Redmond avait alors promis d’écouter les utilisateurs en leur apportant ce qu’ils réclamaient depuis des années. Un chantier colossal que Microsoft a débuté il y a quelques mois déjà à travers Windows K2, son plan secret pour sauver Windows 11.
Des performances en hausse et plus de sécurité
Mais si ajouter des fonctionnalités demandées par les utilisateurs ne semble pas insurmontable, optimiser Windows 11 pour en améliorer ses performances globales est une autre histoire. Et pour cause, le système d’exploitation de Microsoft traîne derrière lui un lourd héritage, le code de Windows 11 étant très largement basé sur les anciennes versions de l’OS.
Un boulet que Microsoft doit donc tenter d’alléger, dans un contexte tout particulier de pénurie de RAM qui a fait exploser les tarifs de celle-ci. Une augmentation de prix qui a d’ailleurs poussé Microsoft à revoir ses exigences pour le cahier des charges de Windows 11, alors que la firme de Redmond conseillait jusqu’à il y a peu, 16 Go de mémoire vive pour utiliser son OS de manière optimale, notamment avec les fonctionnalités liées à l’IA.
Les ingénieurs de Microsoft n’ont donc pas eu d’autre choix que de peaufiner l’optimisation de Windows 11. Microsoft a ainsi confirmé que le temps de démarrage de son système d’exploitation serait bientôt réduit, permettant à l’écran de verrouillage de s’afficher presque immédiatement. Mark Linton, le Vice-Président de la division Windows et Devices chez Microsoft a indiqué que les tests d’évaluations menés en interne sur une mouture qui n’a pas encore été testée auprès des Insiders, avaient révélé des gains de temps significatifs au démarrage de Windows 11. La firme de Redmond aurait tout particulièrement mis le paquet sur l’optimisation du déverrouillage des PC avec Windows Hello, pour rendre celui-ci plus réactif. Une amélioration que devrait être déployée avec la prochaine mise à jour majeure de l’OS.
Windows 11 optimisé pour les PC avec 8 Go de RAM
Pour que Windows 11 soit aussi réactif sur les machines haut de gamme que sur les configurations plus modestes, les ingénieurs de Microsoft ont donc revu leur copie de Windows 11. Un important travail d’optimisation a ainsi été mené pour que le système d’exploitation fonctionne de manière fluide sur un PC avec seulement 8 Go de RAM. Un véritable défi pour Microsoft, alors que bon nombre d’applications courantes sont réputées gourmandes en mémoire, même lorsqu’elles ne sont exécutées qu’en arrière-plan, comme c’est le cas, par exemple, avec Microsoft Teams, ou encore l’application Météo.
Malheureusement pour Microsoft ce travail d’optimisation restera insuffisant pour permettre l’utilisation de son IA localement sur les machines aux petites configurations. L’entreprise de Redmond exige en effet toujours 16 Go de RAM pour que les machines puissent être labellisées Copilot+.
On ne peut cependant que saluer l’effort fourni par Microsoft pour tenter d’améliorer les choses. La firme de Redmond, qui a reconnu ses erreurs de conception en ce qui concerne Windows 11, a multiplié les efforts au cours des derniers mois pour essayer de réhabiliter son OS auprès du public.
Avec son prochain Patch Tuesday, dont le déploiement est prévu pour ce mardi 8 septembre, Microsoft introduira officiellement sa nouvelle barre des tâches, son nouveau menu Démarrer redimensionnable, mais aussi son nouveau moteur de recherche expurgé de Bing.
